SBPEa4GHZ5.evidence: Experiments on seven real-world datasets against representative baselines; an anonymous code repository is provided.
SBPEa4GHZ5.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract says only that SCAMFS outperforms representative baselines on most metrics across seven datasets).

l0cWPpQ3QM.one_liner: Converts per-criterion rubric scores into within-group ordinal comparisons and recovers latent utilities as the RL reward.
l0cWPpQ3QM.problem: Linear aggregation of normalized rubric criteria assumes cardinal score differences are comparable across criteria and that gains on one criterion offset failures on another, which is unreliable for semantically heterogeneous criteria.
l0cWPpQ3QM.method: For each criterion, RLVR^2 turns rubric scores into within-group ordinal outcomes and recovers a latent utility from the within-group comparison matrix. These utilities are converted into a single optimization signal for policy training.
l0cWPpQ3QM.key_idea: Replace weighted-sum reward aggregation with latent utilities recovered from per-criterion within-group comparison matrices, discarding cardinal score magnitudes.
l0cWPpQ3QM.evidence: Compared with static and adaptive reward aggregation at 4B-106B model scale (per the TL;DR); the benchmarks and tasks are not visible in the abstract text provided.
l0cWPpQ3QM.claimed_gains: Beats static and adaptive aggregation by up to 4.2% at 4B-106B scale (from the TL;DR).

eNRM1fPb8F.one_liner: Compares seven representational similarity metrics with hypothesis-driven within-group correspondence and between-group separation tests across models and brains.
eNRM1fPb8F.problem: Representational similarity metrics emphasize different properties, so agreement with one scientific criterion need not extend to another.
eNRM1fPb8F.method: Tests seven widely used metrics on within-group correspondence and between-group separation using 35 vision models on ImageNet, Ecoset, CIFAR10 and CIFAR100, human fMRI from the Natural Scenes Dataset, and mouse Neuropixels recordings from the Allen Brain Observatory.
eNRM1fPb8F.key_idea: Metrics are judged by how well they separate model families and cortical regions and group same-objective models, rather than by agreement on a single criterion.
eNRM1fPb8F.evidence: 35 vision models on four image datasets, human fMRI (Natural Scenes Dataset) and mouse Neuropixels (Allen Brain Observatory), including comparisons across random initializations.

Z9R3U8ACPI.one_liner: Embedding-space flow language model with a data predictor constrained to the token-embedding convex hull and trained with MSE only.
Z9R3U8ACPI.problem: Continuous diffusion and flow language models still need cross-entropy-supervised decoders because their trajectories are not guaranteed to end at valid token embeddings.
Z9R3U8ACPI.method: ConvergeFlow constrains the data predictor to the convex hull of token embeddings and trains it only with the flow-matching MSE objective. Under regularity conditions the flow provably converges to valid token embeddings despite predictor errors, allowing direct token prediction, and three sampling mechanisms trade off generative perplexity against entropy.
Z9R3U8ACPI.key_idea: Restricting the data predictor to the convex hull of token embeddings makes the flow converge to valid token embeddings, removing the need for a CE-supervised decoder.
Z9R3U8ACPI.evidence: A convergence proof under regularity conditions and experiments on OpenWebText against continuous and discrete diffusion language models.

rKsM7IiRfz.one_liner: Benchmark and staged agent scoring scientific figure quality from separate visual and text evidence, fused by a deterministic runner.
rKsM7IiRfz.problem: Image quality and chart-understanding methods ignore alignment among a figure, its caption, and its citing paragraph, and a single end-to-end prompt mixes visible content with textual claims.
rKsM7IiRfz.method: SciFigQual-Bench binds published CS-conference figures to captions and index-resolved citing paragraphs and scores visual clarity, layout, caption consistency, context consistency, and misleading risk, leaving a dimension unevaluated when its evidence is absent. SFQ-Agent reads image and text in separate calls, a cross-modal judge scores caption and citing-text alignment from those reports, and a deterministic runner keeps visual scores, sets misleading risk by a fixed rule, and applies written caps.
rKsM7IiRfz.key_idea: Separate modality-specific evidence calls for image and text, then a deterministic runner applies fixed rules and caps so each dimension follows the rubric.
rKsM7IiRfz.evidence: Experiments compare the staged judge with single-pass and OCR-sidecar baselines on the benchmark; the abstract is cut off before the results.

8xd72b6vk7.one_liner: Evidence-guided trajectory dataset and step-level RL (SEPO) training omni video agents to find, connect, and correct evidence.
8xd72b6vk7.problem: Existing data pipelines give limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for finding, connecting, and correcting evidence in omni (audio-visual) video settings.
8xd72b6vk7.method: Builds the OmniCoach dataset (named 240k, later 340k in the abstract) with multi-span and reflection trajectories from a three-stage pipeline using fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Trains with Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO), which gives turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization.
8xd72b6vk7.key_idea: Turn-level RL credit computed from improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization, trained on multi-span and reflection trajectories.
8xd72b6vk7.evidence: Open OmniAgent models are evaluated on multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks, nine benchmarks including LVOmniBench, against baselines including Qwen3-Omni.
8xd72b6vk7.claimed_gains: Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and a second benchmark cut off in the abstract.

FFxUAI94JI.one_liner: Training-free asynchronous LLM framework where inference coroutines share overlapping memory states, letting existing LLMs act concurrently.
FFxUAI94JI.problem: LLM agents follow sequential read-think-reply cycles, but voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while thinking or acting.
FFxUAI94JI.method: A framework lets users, or the agents themselves, define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states, so one model can handle different types of concurrency.
FFxUAI94JI.key_idea: Run LLM inference as coroutines over overlapping memory states so new inputs can arrive during reasoning, without task-specific training.
FFxUAI94JI.evidence: Qwen 3.x models shown on streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring.

bdCBfxK4o8.one_liner: Reweights ViT frame attention using post-softmax frame confidence and intra-frame concentration, with no extra trainable parameters.
bdCBfxK4o8.problem: ViT video models are biased toward dominant global motions and coarse temporal dynamics, limiting sensitivity to subtle, localized facial dynamics.
bdCBfxK4o8.method: MiRA derives frame-level confidence and intra-frame concentration from post-softmax attention, combines them into a framewise importance score used as a prior to reallocate attention across frames, and offers a flashLite mode that approximates this pre-softmax from key-based proxy statistics inside FlashAttention kernels.
bdCBfxK4o8.key_idea: Derive a framewise importance prior from each frame's attention mass and spatial concentration, then use it to redistribute attention across frames.
bdCBfxK4o8.evidence: Extensive experiments on video facial expression recognition are mentioned, but the results are cut off in the abstract.

hRSpuaLKkC.one_liner: Organizes agent-harness search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies, then routes each input to a branch head.
hRSpuaLKkC.problem: Meta-Harness uses a fixed development set and proposal policy, channeling evolution along a single trajectory with a risk of converging to a local optimum.
hRSpuaLKkC.method: Each branch keeps development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by other branches', drops cases solved by every leading harness across branches, and revises its proposal policy from its own search history; a router selects one branch head per new input.
hRSpuaLKkC.key_idea: Make the improvement process adaptive: branches specialize through evolving development subsets and proposal policies, and a router picks the development-selected head per input.
hRSpuaLKkC.evidence: Mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, including Olympiad-level math, Terminal-Bench 2.0, and SWE-bench Lite, with selection based solely on development data.
hRSpuaLKkC.claimed_gains: Relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite.

2mGC6HQ7V8.one_liner: Benchmark scoring text-to-audio prompt fidelity per field with an audio-language-model judge whose probes are validated against a noise control.
2mGC6HQ7V8.problem: Prevailing text-to-audio measures judge a clip against its prompt as a whole and cannot show which parts of the prompt are missed.
2mGC6HQ7V8.method: Scene-description properties are organized into 25 fields and judged by a large audio-language model; for each field the probe whose accuracy depends most on audio, relative to a Gaussian-noise control, is kept, and human raters set per-field ceilings.
2mGC6HQ7V8.key_idea: Score prompt fidelity as per-field structured alignment, using judge probes selected for audio dependence against a Gaussian-noise control.
2mGC6HQ7V8.evidence: 11 models on 2,500 generation prompts (100 per field); human raters confirm the judge detects 23 of the 25 fields in generated audio.

zLiOihSqGY.one_liner: Few-shot font generation with a unified glyph-image and component-sequence content representation and temperature-adjusted style aggregation.
zLiOihSqGY.problem: Few-shot font generation content sources are limited to either glyph images or component sequences, and conventional cross-attention fails to suppress irrelevant style features, causing inconsistency for identical components.
zLiOihSqGY.method: A Unified-Content Representer aligns glyph images and component sequences across modalities at local and global levels, and a Temperature-Adjusted Style Aggregator uses component-similarity-conditioned attention; the model is built on diffusion or flow matching with fused content and style conditions.
zLiOihSqGY.key_idea: Align image and component-sequence content in one representation, and sharpen style aggregation with attention conditioned on component similarity.
zLiOihSqGY.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before the experiments; not stated.

UtWakRp7J0.one_liner: Curating a three-system neuroaesthetic photography dataset trains an MLLM for fine-grained attribute scoring, VAD emotion rating, and aesthetic critique.
UtWakRp7J0.problem: Multimodal LLM image aesthetic evaluators typically output a single holistic score or generic critique rather than fine-grained attribute ratings and structured multidimensional reasoning.
UtWakRp7J0.method: Drawing on neuroaesthetics across sensory-motor, emotion-valuation, and knowledge-meaning systems, the authors construct NeuroAes—25K photographic images annotated with over 1.2M labels across 48 subcategories and over 2.25M valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) ratings—and train the all-in-one AesMind multimodal LLM.
UtWakRp7J0.key_idea: Organize aesthetic supervision and MLLM training around sensory-motor, emotion-valuation, and knowledge-meaning neuroaesthetic systems paired with valence-arousal-dominance emotion ratings.
UtWakRp7J0.evidence: Builds the 25K-image NeuroAes dataset, split into a 20K NeuroAes-Data training set and a 5K NeuroAes-Bench evaluation benchmark, to train and evaluate AesMind.

axGVOn6Pd8.one_liner: Variational encoder variance from an LLM-pretrained semantic latent space governs confidence-weighted Bayesian message fusion in multi-agent reinforcement learning.
axGVOn6Pd8.problem: Multi-agent reinforcement learning communication methods pursue either information-theoretic compression or language grounding without linking what information to transmit with partial-observability uncertainty.
axGVOn6Pd8.method: SIGMA uses a one-time LLM annotation of a small observation subset with KL regularization to pretrain a semantically structured variational latent space. During joint policy-encoder training and execution, agents transmit local latent distribution parameters whose variance sigma weights received messages via confidence-weighted Bayesian fusion.
axGVOn6Pd8.key_idea: Pretrain a variational communication encoder from sparse LLM annotations and transmit latent distribution parameters whose variance sigma weights inter-agent messages in Bayesian fusion.
axGVOn6Pd8.evidence: Evaluated on standard multi-agent reinforcement learning benchmarks including tests under reduced communication budgets.

75zQdOc9fM.one_liner: Auditing frozen UAV decisions against typed public evidence certifies supported interpretations or compiles explicit safe-hold abstentions.
75zQdOc9fM.problem: Executable UAV actions may still have incorrect semantics, grounding, or evidence, which isolated validity and trajectory metrics fail to detect jointly.
75zQdOc9fM.method: The paper defines executable world hypotheses coupling intended operations, typed grounding, epistemic support, and deterministic rollout, with EWHC as an end-to-end criterion. CERES audits a frozen completion against typed public evidence and certifies a unique supported interpretation or compiles a safe-hold abstention.
75zQdOc9fM.key_idea: Resolve a frozen action hypothesis against typed public evidence, certifying unique grounding and support or compiling abstention into a safe hold.
75zQdOc9fM.evidence: AeroWorld-32K contains 4,096 executable UAV scenes and 32,768 causally paired queries, evaluated across ten frozen language-model configurations and six deterministic comparators.

t7q6KAdZl0.one_liner: Distilling compatible structural tokens with annealed teacher weights transfers autoregressive predictions into discrete diffusion language models.
t7q6KAdZl0.problem: Autoregressive teachers and discrete diffusion students condition on different contexts, making direct predictive-distribution distillation unreliable.
t7q6KAdZl0.method: WEAN applies autoregressive supervision selectively at reliable structural token positions where teacher and student predictions are more compatible. It adjusts distillation strength by denoising step and training stage, reducing guidance as the student adapts.
t7q6KAdZl0.key_idea: Distill autoregressive predictions at compatible structural tokens while annealing guidance across denoising steps and training stages.
t7q6KAdZl0.evidence: The abstract reports experimental improvements in generation quality but truncates before completing the result or specifying evaluation settings.

AzpAUUWB8C.one_liner: Reciprocal voice-profile and style-reconstruction rewards jointly train instruction-controlled speech synthesis and paralinguistic understanding.
AzpAUUWB8C.problem: Separately trained speech synthesis and paralinguistic understanding leave reciprocal feedback between generation and understanding underused.
AzpAUUWB8C.method: CycleSpeech connects both tasks through structured voice profiles and joint supervised fine-tuning. CycleGRPO alternates policy updates using profile-consistency and speaking-style reconstruction rewards anchored by fixed targets, without human preference labels or an additional preference-trained reward model.
AzpAUUWB8C.key_idea: Use shared structured voice profiles to reward both recovery of source profiles and reconstruction of source speaking style in reciprocal training loops.
AzpAUUWB8C.evidence: A bilingual dataset pairs 20,046 instructions, utterances, speaker references, and profiles, supporting independent instruction-adherence evaluations and bilingual profile-recovery benchmarks.

LdyTLszA0f.one_liner: A one-step diffusion policy iteratively edits UAV schedules, using imitation pretraining and PPO to optimize long-horizon improvement.
LdyTLszA0f.problem: Coupled payload, energy, and timing constraints let local schedule changes propagate, making one-shot UAV schedule generation difficult.
LdyTLszA0f.method: LIFT predicts structured edits on a schedule-dependent candidate graph and decodes them into feasible successor schedules. It learns from expert improvement trajectories before PPO fine-tuning through a one-step denoiser with tractable conditional action log-probabilities.
LdyTLszA0f.key_idea: Treat one-step diffusion outputs as feasible schedule edits in a sequential refinement policy with tractable likelihoods for PPO.
LdyTLszA0f.evidence: Training on small instances yields the lowest mean total arrival time across the evaluated benchmark configurations and generalization to larger problems without retraining.

UBxDeOaCH4.one_liner: Consolidating shared 2D-to-3D proposals through static aggregation and dynamic association produces consistent object boxes and trajectories.
UBxDeOaCH4.problem: Static 3D pipelines discard motion, while independent framewise detection produces noisy boxes, fragmented identities, and inconsistent trajectories.
UBxDeOaCH4.method: SPAFoundry uses Boxer to generate 2D-to-3D proposals from posed visual sequences. Its static path aggregates observations in a common world frame, while its dynamic path associates moving instances over time and exports boxes and trajectories in a common annotation format.
UBxDeOaCH4.key_idea: Consolidate shared 2D-to-3D proposals by world-frame aggregation for static objects and temporal association for moving objects.
UBxDeOaCH4.evidence: Experiments compare against Boxer on ScanNet and measure dynamic box and tracking performance on 20 Aria Digital Twin sequences.
UBxDeOaCH4.claimed_gains: SPAFoundry improves ScanNet AP25 from 0.32 to 0.68 over Boxer and achieves 30.88% dynamic 3D box IoU and 54.31% HOTA0.1 on 20 Aria Digital Twin sequences.

PCa95SLlMU.one_liner: StreamHaR combines per-frame wrist geometry, articulation encoding, and causal metric odometry to reconstruct hands online.
PCa95SLlMU.problem: Offline world-space hand reconstruction requires future frames and global optimization, limiting interactive use.
PCa95SLlMU.method: StreamHaR estimates wrist location with per-frame Perspective-n-Point on projection-consistent keypoints, articulation with an encoder, and camera motion with a causal odometer scaled by monocular depth. It emits metric world-space hands with constant-size state and no look-ahead, bundle adjustment, or calibration.
PCa95SLlMU.key_idea: Factor world-space hand reconstruction into geometric wrist estimation, encoded articulation, and causally estimated metric camera motion.
PCa95SLlMU.evidence: With its own detector and zero look-ahead, StreamHaR matches offline world-space accuracy, lowers articulation error, and transfers zero-shot to unseen headsets.

7uhoegd7SB.one_liner: ReAL-AHD plans heuristic search over derivation and similarity graphs, jointly selecting algorithm families, parents, and operators.
7uhoegd7SB.problem: Automatic heuristic design discards search relationships or captures only one structure and underuses history for evaluation allocation and expansion decisions.
7uhoegd7SB.method: ReAL-AHD records algorithm lineages in a derivation graph and groups heuristics using PreferSim action-preference similarity. Hierarchical planning allocates family budgets, jointly chooses parent-operator pairs, and reuses past outcomes through graph-aware memory.
7uhoegd7SB.key_idea: Use complementary lineage and behavioral-similarity graphs to allocate evaluation budgets and jointly plan parent-operator expansions.
7uhoegd7SB.evidence: Experiments span five combinatorial optimization problems and three heuristic paradigms.

mFHjF5TtJo.one_liner: Explicit mode switching combines search and browser operation within a shared-history web-agent trajectory.
mFHjF5TtJo.problem: Real-world web tasks require both information gathering and interaction, but agents usually develop and evaluate these capabilities separately.
mFHjF5TtJo.method: HyWe uses separate prompts and tool sets for search and operation, with explicit switching and shared history. HyWeCollector synthesizes verified hybrid demonstrations to train HyWe-35B, while HyWeBench evaluates completion through sub-goal checklists.
mFHjF5TtJo.key_idea: Switch between dedicated search and operation modes while preserving a shared trajectory that carries findings across modes.
mFHjF5TtJo.evidence: HyWeBench contains 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training and compares hybrid training, existing agents, and untrained prompting configurations.
mFHjF5TtJo.claimed_gains: HyWe-35B reaches 47.0% success, gaining 19.0 percentage points over the untrained base model; before training, HyWe achieves 28.0% versus 11.0% with one all-tools prompt.

K3eayrekBA.one_liner: Closed-form subspace constraints suppress interference between successive diffusion-model concept erasures.
K3eayrekBA.problem: Repeated concept erasures can interfere, degrade unrelated generations, and destabilize earlier erasures.
K3eayrekBA.method: CEASE adds the shared replacement token representation to a closed-form solver's invariance matrix. When interference appears, it projects the update away from dominant output directions of cumulative past updates.
K3eayrekBA.key_idea: Constrain the shared replacement representation and project current edits away from dominant directions of prior cumulative updates.
K3eayrekBA.evidence: A closed-form interference decomposition supports the constraints, and continual erasure experiments cover celebrities, artistic styles, and instances.

tavkE39V2j.one_liner: Learned relative value movements redistribute step-level credit while preserving advantage signs and each direction's total credit.
tavkE39V2j.problem: Non-parametric step-level credit can misallocate magnitudes, while learned value errors can reverse policy update directions.
tavkE39V2j.method: GRAW treats non-parametric advantages as the allocation prior and uses learned relative value movements only to reweight actions with the same update direction. It preserves every advantage sign and total absolute credit separately in each direction.
tavkE39V2j.key_idea: Use learned value movement to redistribute advantage magnitude within sign groups while conserving each group's total absolute credit.
tavkE39V2j.evidence: Experiments span three long-horizon agent benchmarks and multiple model scales, with non-parametric step-level estimators as comparison points.

nFAnW8Dws9.one_liner: Cooperating agents translate cinematographic instructions into executable camera motions and refine them using rendered visual feedback.
nFAnW8Dws9.problem: Translating cinematic intent into controllable camera trajectories for dynamic 3D scenes remains difficult.
nFAnW8Dws9.method: FilmFlow's Director composes concurrent atomic operations controlling camera translation, rotation, and framing. Interpreter, Scout, and Critic agents extract intent, select initial viewpoints, and refine plans through rendered feedback.
nFAnW8Dws9.key_idea: Compose executable camera plans from concurrent atomic motions, then revise them using scene-grounded interpretation and rendered-result criticism.
nFAnW8Dws9.evidence: CinemaBench evaluates text- and video-directed camera generation using 150 Blender scenes, 750 text-directed tasks, and 60 reference videos, alongside user preferences.

eNIhl45SRt.one_liner: A learned energy model selects financial reasoning demonstrations using historical market compatibility and feedback reliability.
eNIhl45SRt.problem: Synthetic financial supervision lacks independent outcome verification, while market feedback can be delayed, noisy, and confounded.
eNIhl45SRt.method: WISER locks response candidates before accessing outcomes and trains a World Feedback Energy model using nonoverlapping selection and confirmation windows. Constrained Bayesian optimization selects its configuration within 64 evaluations before response selection for student fine-tuning.
eNIhl45SRt.key_idea: Select precommitted candidate responses through an energy model that learns interactions among response attributes, market compatibility, and feedback reliability.
eNIhl45SRt.evidence: Evaluation covers 255 post-freeze financial events across China, the United States, Europe, and Japan, comparing WISER with Direct WF Score.
eNIhl45SRt.claimed_gains: WISER reports gains of 0.024 in Entity NDCG@5, 0.027 in Direction MCC, and 0.10 in cost adjusted Sharpe over Direct WF Score.

1t065bxYzi.one_liner: Distillation compresses multimodal information-flow pathways according to their proportional scaling across model depths.
1t065bxYzi.problem: Large multimodal models exceed resource budgets, motivating distillation that transfers their intermediate processing behavior to smaller models.
1t065bxYzi.method: The paper analyzes information flow among text, images, and the final generation token, identifying text understanding, multimodal processing, and response generation stages. Its distillation scheme compresses this flow using the observed proportional scaling with layer count.
1t065bxYzi.key_idea: Transfer intermediate information-flow pathways from larger to smaller multimodal models using their proportional organization across depth.
1t065bxYzi.evidence: The abstract reports information-flow analysis across model sizes and experiments, but does not name datasets or evaluation metrics.

K8J6zYRZrO.one_liner: Failure feedback and a target-specific proxy discriminator guide image-pool selection for multimodal jailbreak evaluation.
K8J6zYRZrO.problem: Multimodal jailbreak searches underuse failed attempts and overlook target-specific vulnerability patterns.
K8J6zYRZrO.method: FAME selects candidates from a pregenerated image pool, using local neighborhood avoidance and global energy attenuation to suppress regions associated with failures. Across attacks, a lightweight discriminator learns target-specific candidate priorities from historical outcomes.
K8J6zYRZrO.key_idea: Combine failure-based candidate suppression with a proxy discriminator trained on historical outcomes to adapt image selection to each target model.
K8J6zYRZrO.evidence: Experiments compare attack success against baselines on four benchmarks and eight open-source and commercial multimodal models.
K8J6zYRZrO.claimed_gains: FAME reports 9.1% higher average attack success rate over the evaluated baselines.

siiPC9Pv9p.one_liner: Language-only action queries anchor scene-conditioned queries through distribution alignment and an auxiliary action-prediction loss.
siiPC9Pv9p.problem: VLA policies often exploit vision-action correlations instead of using instructions to select task-relevant visual evidence.
siiPC9Pv9p.method: LANCE learns language-only queries that form a language anchor and multimodal queries that form scene-conditioned action representations. Reciprocal Alignment couples their distributions, while PriorAction trains the language anchor to predict actions.
siiPC9Pv9p.key_idea: Align scene-conditioned action-query distributions with a language-only anchor trained to distinguish actions through an auxiliary prediction objective.
siiPC9Pv9p.evidence: Experiments across unseen settings report improved instruction-consistent target selection, but the supplied abstract does not name benchmarks or give numerical results.

6INfgJbusG.one_liner: Answer-masked likelihood gains in frozen students score teaching hints under grounding and anti-leakage checks.
6INfgJbusG.problem: Raw pretraining text lacks teaching-utility feedback, and apparent student gains can reflect answer leakage.
6INfgJbusG.method: SIMPLE constructs source-grounded teaching events and scores valid hints through answer-masked gains in frozen students' answer log-likelihood. Coverage correction assigns zero utility when no valid hint exists; supervised imitation and reward-filtered preference refinement train the teacher.
6INfgJbusG.key_idea: Reward hints by answer-masked likelihood gains in frozen students, allowing credit only after grounding and anti-hacking checks.
6INfgJbusG.evidence: Eight benchmark-derived evaluations with two small-model backbones compare coverage-corrected teaching utility against evaluated alternatives.

Jeo0c7YwbA.one_liner: Direct item scoring separates shared semantic-code representations from autoregressive recommendation targets.
Jeo0c7YwbA.problem: Autoregressive semantic-ID supervision may weaken recommendation ranking even when shared codes provide useful item representations.
Jeo0c7YwbA.method: The paper analyzes the expressivity and supervision structure of autoregressive semantic-ID paths under controlled comparisons. NRP follows the resulting decoupling principle by composing shared SID embeddings into complete-item representations for direct item prediction.
Jeo0c7YwbA.key_idea: Retain compositional semantic-ID embeddings for representation while making complete items the prediction targets instead of autoregressive code paths.
Jeo0c7YwbA.evidence: Distribution-level analysis and progressively matched comparisons with exact catalog ranking find direct item scoring stronger and reject invalid-continuation competition as an explanation.

w6g2NYx7q3.one_liner: Paired odor-text perturbations measure how unverified nonvisual cues change vision-language model judgments.
w6g2NYx7q3.problem: It is unclear whether VLM responses to auxiliary nonvisual text reflect cue meaning, generic prompt sensitivity, or calibrated evidence weighting.
w6g2NYx7q3.method: SCENTINEL holds images and questions fixed while varying odor text across absent, congruent, incongruent, irrelevant, and adversarial conditions. Paired behavioral contrasts and audits of stated evidence sources assess cue influence, including ignore-odor instructions and delayed cues.
w6g2NYx7q3.key_idea: Keep visual evidence and questions constant while varying odor descriptions, then compare paired judgments and cited evidence sources.
w6g2NYx7q3.evidence: Evaluation spans 1,200 visually under-specified items in eight domains and seven VLMs, with instruction and cue-timing controls.
w6g2NYx7q3.claimed_gains: Incongruent and adversarial cues yield irrelevant-controlled shifts of 27.4 percentage points and 30.0 points, respectively; ignore-odor instructions reduce these contrasts by 89.8% and 83.7%.

dL8Mtkxbi7.one_liner: Four-camera reconstruction and sparse human alignment capture whole-body motion, object trajectories, and scene constraints for large-object handling.
dL8Mtkxbi7.problem: Learning scene-constrained large-object handling lacks scalable demonstrations of coordinated body motion, object control, and obstacle avoidance.
dL8Mtkxbi7.method: SLoHa combines four exocentric cameras with reconstruction priors and sparse human-assisted alignment to recover human motion, object geometry, 6D poses, and scene constraints in shared coordinates. It provides a dataset and a scene-conditioned handling benchmark without specialized motion-capture suits or object markers.
dL8Mtkxbi7.key_idea: Align camera-based human and object reconstructions with scene constraints in one coordinate system using sparse human assistance.
dL8Mtkxbi7.evidence: SLoHa contains 21.4 hours of demonstrations involving 150 large objects and 435 obstacle layouts, with a scene-conditioned handling benchmark.

s6DReQqdMQ.one_liner: Joint physics, depth, appearance, and camera representations support multimodal 3D world generation and reconstruction.
s6DReQqdMQ.problem: Constructing and interacting with 3D worlds requires coordinated physical understanding, spatial simulation, and reconstruction within a unified model.
s6DReQqdMQ.method: Puffin-World jointly models gravity field and latitude, depth, and images with an Omni-Camera representation, propagating physical dynamics across future frames. A single generative process couples future-view synthesis with geometry reconstruction for closed-loop applications.
s6DReQqdMQ.key_idea: Jointly model physics, geometry, appearance, and camera state while generating each future view together with its depth.
s6DReQqdMQ.evidence: The paper constructs Puffin-16M with 15 million vision-language-camera triplets and 1 million trajectories featuring varied motions.

drp6gf7Elo.one_liner: Augmented-view disagreement from a frozen Siamese network identifies noisy labels for correction or removal.
drp6gf7Elo.problem: Corrupted labels degrade classifier stability and generalization, motivating data cleaning before final-model training.
drp6gf7Elo.method: A Siamese network trains once with contrastive and classification losses, then predicts across twelve augmentation families. Label disagreement flags suspicious samples; sufficiently consistent predictions supply replacement labels, while other flagged samples are removed.
drp6gf7Elo.key_idea: Measure disagreement between augmented-view predictions and recorded labels, then relabel consistent alternatives and remove uncertain samples.
drp6gf7Elo.evidence: Across all eleven settings with reference labels, mislabeled samples show higher average disagreement, supported by a theoretical decomposition of the expected disagreement gap.

4XWcFayyx0.one_liner: Prior supervision calibration trains manifold adapters and a continuous residual flow that refines image-text retrieval scores.
4XWcFayyx0.problem: Remote sensing image-text retrieval insufficiently calibrates both training correspondences and posterior matching scores.
4XWcFayyx0.method: P²Cal first purifies supervision through a Prior Semantic Calibration Module and trains lightweight Manifold Residual Adapters. Its Posterior Score Calibration Flow treats matching scores as initial states and learns a continuous residual velocity field to refine them.
4XWcFayyx0.key_idea: Use calibrated semantic supervision to learn representation adapters and a continuous flow that updates retrieval scores.
4XWcFayyx0.evidence: Experiments on multiple unnamed remote sensing image-text retrieval datasets compare P²Cal against existing methods.

ttdyEHaykx.one_liner: Wasserstein distributional robustness controls worst-case surrogate bias through adversarial perturbations of offline training samples.
ttdyEHaykx.problem: Overconfident surrogate predictions outside the training distribution drive offline model-based optimization toward spurious optima.
ttdyEHaykx.method: BiaWDRO constrains worst-case predictive bias within Wasserstein ambiguity sets and uses Lagrangian duality to obtain tractable adversarial sample perturbations. It also derives a lower bound on empirical fitting error to characterize the cost of bias control.
ttdyEHaykx.key_idea: Dualize worst-case predictive bias over Wasserstein ambiguity sets into an objective using adversarially perturbed training samples.
ttdyEHaykx.evidence: The paper provides a duality-based objective and an empirical-fitting lower bound, with experiments across offline optimization tasks on Design-Bench.

0YPl4uolbM.one_liner: Self-verified atomic visual claims condition a frozen teacher for on-policy distillation of less hallucinatory generation.
0YPl4uolbM.problem: Multimodal models can recognize image-inconsistent claims during verification yet still generate those hallucinations.
0YPl4uolbM.method: SVG-OPD elicits fact-oriented and probing responses, decomposes them into atomic claims, and verifies each against the image. Verified claims become privileged context for a frozen teacher whose token distributions supervise student-generated trajectories.
0YPl4uolbM.key_idea: Convert self-verified visual claims into privileged teacher context and distill the resulting token distributions on student-generated trajectories.
0YPl4uolbM.evidence: The supplied abstract mentions generative and discriminative hallucination experiments but does not provide complete settings or results.

ndskdH5kcY.one_liner: Periodic soft resets, randomized Q-target minimization, and replay augmentation support actor-critic training at high replay ratios.
ndskdH5kcY.problem: High replay ratios intensify neuron dormancy, reducing network capacity and destabilizing reinforcement learning.
ndskdH5kcY.method: ScaleAC periodically soft-resets agent networks to address dormant neurons, adds in-target random minimization to stabilize Q learning, and augments replay data to limit overfitting. The approach builds on actor-critic algorithms with theoretical insights.
ndskdH5kcY.key_idea: Counter high-update-frequency dormancy and overfitting through soft network resets, randomized target minimization, and augmented replay samples.
ndskdH5kcY.evidence: Experiments in MuJoCo and DMC cover vector-based and pixel-based reinforcement learning at increased replay ratios.
ndskdH5kcY.claimed_gains: ScaleAC scales vector-based RL replay ratios up to 256 and also scales replay ratios in pixel-based RL.

HEBM6JT7Ti.one_liner: Process-adaptive gating switches between predictive and reactive action experts conditioned on world-model physical priors.
HEBM6JT7Ti.problem: World action models trade generalizable transit against precise interaction under separate prediction-driven and joint-modeling approaches.
HEBM6JT7Ti.method: HarmoWAM supplies spatio-temporal world-model priors to a predictive expert that iteratively generates actions from latent dynamics and a reactive expert that infers actions from predicted visual evolution. A Process-Adaptive Gating Mechanism selects when and where to switch experts.
HEBM6JT7Ti.key_idea: Gate between latent-dynamics action generation and visual-evolution action inference using shared world-model priors and process-dependent switching.
HEBM6JT7Ti.evidence: Systematic experiments compare generalizable transit and interaction precision between Imagine-then-Execute and Joint Modeling approaches, without named benchmarks in the supplied abstract.

w6xkNPe10L.one_liner: Blocking and accelerated gossip adapt Online Newton Step to decentralized optimization with exp-concave losses.
w6xkNPe10L.problem: Achieving logarithmic regret for decentralized online exp-concave optimization remains unresolved in prior work.
w6xkNPe10L.method: D-ONS combines blocking and accelerated gossip with Online Newton Step using local computations and communication. The analysis establishes upper and nearly matching lower regret bounds and extends the method to unbounded-domain online linear regression.
w6xkNPe10L.key_idea: Combine blocked Online Newton Step updates with accelerated gossip to coordinate decentralized learners under exp-concave losses.
w6xkNPe10L.evidence: Theoretical results establish regret upper and lower bounds and a logarithmic-regret extension to decentralized online linear regression with an unbounded feasible domain.
w6xkNPe10L.claimed_gains: D-ONS achieves regret \(\mathcal{O}(Nd(1-\sigma_2)^{-1/2}\log^2(T))\), with a lower bound of \(\Omega(Nd(1-\sigma_2)^{-1/2}\log(T/N))\).

VQxHuJBjcn.one_liner: Equivalent problem descriptions test language models' requirement understanding and end-to-end optimization modeling.
VQxHuJBjcn.problem: Optimization-modeling accuracy benchmarks provide limited evidence of robustness to equivalent natural-language reformulations.
VQxHuJBjcn.method: RobustOpt constructs alternative descriptions intended to preserve each optimization problem and checks them against original requirements. It evaluates requirement understanding through question answering and end-to-end modeling through coding.
VQxHuJBjcn.key_idea: Rephrase optimization problems while preserving requirements, then test both requirement understanding and solver-code generation.
VQxHuJBjcn.evidence: The study observes failures on differently described versions of problems that LLMs originally modeled correctly; specific evaluated models and datasets are not stated.

JHQ0qQofFg.one_liner: Shared group-level modes jointly condition individual goals and evolving interactions for multimodal human trajectory prediction.
JHQ0qQofFg.problem: Similar individual goals can lead to different joint trajectories as social interactions evolve.
JHQ0qQofFg.method: GroupModes builds observation-conditioned modes with bounded stochastic residuals, using each mode to specify goals and modulate time-varying interaction logits through a low-rank parameterization. A synchronous goal-conditioned decoder predicts target and neighbor trajectories jointly.
JHQ0qQofFg.key_idea: Condition individual goals and low-rank time-varying interaction logits on the same group mode before synchronous trajectory decoding.
JHQ0qQofFg.evidence: Comparisons with joint predictors, shared-mode analyses, and multiple-seed evaluations support target and joint forecasting performance.

NCKszTZpsm.one_liner: Disjoint skill libraries and labeled retrieval queries benchmark and train skill selection for language-model agents.
NCKszTZpsm.problem: Large skill libraries make explicit skill invocation impractical, while realistic skill-retrieval benchmarks remain limited.
NCKszTZpsm.method: SkillRet organizes public agent skills with semantic tags and a two-level taxonomy, providing training samples and evaluation queries over disjoint skill pools. It benchmarks retrievers and supports task-specific fine-tuning.
NCKszTZpsm.key_idea: Pair skill-retrieval queries with taxonomy-organized libraries while separating training and evaluation skill pools.
NCKszTZpsm.evidence: Experiments compare retrievers on 16,129 skills, using 63,259 training samples and 4,392 evaluation queries.
NCKszTZpsm.claimed_gains: Task-specific fine-tuning improves NDCG@10 by 12.9 points over the strongest prior retriever and by 16.2 points over the strongest off-the-shelf retriever.

bOFu3FimAt.one_liner: Tracing representation provenance detects generation-history takeover and selectively reinforces visual-origin components during vision-language decoding.
bOFu3FimAt.problem: Token positions do not reliably identify information origins after transformer layers mix visual and textual representations.
bOFu3FimAt.method: TRACE propagates contributions from visual inputs, user queries, and generation history through intermediate representations. During decoding, it detects abnormal dominance of generation-history provenance and reinforces the corresponding visual-origin component without additional training.
bOFu3FimAt.key_idea: Track source contributions through representations and strengthen visual-origin components when generation-history provenance takes over.
bOFu3FimAt.evidence: Representation analysis identifies generation-history dominance before hallucinated tokens; the supplied abstract does not specify benchmark names or results.

HCvhA3sKoT.one_liner: Fixing one low-rank factor restricts LoRA's adaptation subspace, with a chained-circulant variant further structuring the update.
HCvhA3sKoT.problem: The extent to which fine-tuning can restrict adaptation space without sacrificing performance or generalization remains unclear.
HCvhA3sKoT.method: Cheap LoRA trains one low-rank factor while fixing the other; c^3LA adds a chained-circulant structure. The paper treats these as column-subspace restrictions and derives information-theoretic generalization bounds.
HCvhA3sKoT.key_idea: Restrict trainable updates to a controlled column subspace by fixing one LoRA factor, optionally imposing chained-circulant structure.
HCvhA3sKoT.evidence: The study compares 11 fine-tuning methods across 10 pretrained models and 14 datasets using performance, generalization, loss-landscape, and spectral analyses.
HCvhA3sKoT.claimed_gains: cLA and c^3LA reduce training time relative to LoRA by up to 14.4% and peak GPU memory by up to 11%.

FZ0RQAyVHY.one_liner: Task-dependent channel and layer selection combines with token feature reuse to allocate computation throughout multimodal diffusion decoding.
FZ0RQAyVHY.problem: Shared multimodal diffusion networks obscure how task-specific computational demands and token update needs change during denoising.
FZ0RQAyVHY.method: S²I-dLLM reduces channels and selects layers by task requirements, restoring computation as denoising progresses. Token stability governs feature reuse, while prediction states control refinement and commitment timing.
FZ0RQAyVHY.key_idea: Adapt channel and layer execution to task demands while using token stability and prediction state to schedule feature reuse and output commitment.
FZ0RQAyVHY.evidence: The supplied abstract reports analyses of network structure and token evolution and mentions experiments, but does not specify benchmarks or numerical results.

3O0yAu7ZA8.one_liner: Ordered claim verification locates the first mathematical error and directs correction while checking missing solution branches.
3O0yAu7ZA8.problem: Mathematical self-reflection struggles to locate critical errors, while answer-only verification can miss necessary solution branches.
3O0yAu7ZA8.method: AGPV decomposes solutions into ordered claims, verifies them with a shared mathematical toolbox, and stops at the first error. A summarizer diagnoses the failure for a correction agent, after which verification adapts to the revised solution and checks completeness.
3O0yAu7ZA8.key_idea: Verify ordered claims until the first failure, then use its evidence to re-derive the remaining solution and check branch completeness.
3O0yAu7ZA8.evidence: The paper proves correctness and completeness when claims sufficiently cover the solution, local verification is reliable, and every claim passes verification.

7zy11kFbLf.one_liner: Planning-stage guardrail feedback supplies proceed, refuse, or update decisions that guide agents to revise unsafe action plans.
7zy11kFbLf.problem: Guardrails can block entire tasks when malicious content contaminates otherwise benign work, without showing whether agents subsequently behave more safely.
7zy11kFbLf.method: TRIAD provides safety feedback at each planning step so agents can remediate action plans before execution. Its Tri-Guard model is fine-tuned on a self-curated dataset to generate a safety analysis and a proceed, refuse, or update decision.
7zy11kFbLf.key_idea: Insert detailed guardrail analysis and a three-way decision into the agent's planning context to guide action-plan revision before execution.

Ey62HqacSn.one_liner: A linear buffer before the language-model head absorbs the final-layer representation jump and changes intermediate vocabulary readouts.
Ey62HqacSn.problem: Abrupt final-layer changes make intermediate hidden states less compatible with the final language-model head, distorting Logit Lens interpretations.
Ey62HqacSn.method: Architectural ablations locate the jump in the final feed-forward network. Inserting a linear buffer before the LM head relocates the jump, enabling comparisons of intermediate representations and vocabulary projections.
Ey62HqacSn.key_idea: Insert a linear buffer before the LM head so it absorbs the representation jump previously concentrated in the final feed-forward layer.
Ey62HqacSn.evidence: Ablations and comparisons between models with and without the jump find similar intermediate representations but substantially different Logit Lens readouts.

TsCdv2udoe.one_liner: Original-image answer-support measurements predict whether regional image edits change a vision-language model's answer.
TsCdv2udoe.problem: Correct answers on original images do not reveal whether vision-language models will follow regional edits or preserve their previous answers.
TsCdv2udoe.method: GLANCE combines original-answer support from three fixed views, with original-image scoring separated from edited-image labels. The protocol evaluates conditional target-following versus preservation and any answer change, alongside simpler readouts and validity audits.
TsCdv2udoe.key_idea: Combine three original-image answer-support views to predict later answer changes without using edited-image labels during scoring.
TsCdv2udoe.evidence: Tests cover nine Visual7W cohorts, matched probes, a three-rater audit of 200 edits, a second editing workflow, and a prospective audit on 500 new-source items.
TsCdv2udoe.claimed_gains: T1 AUROC is 0.707–0.832 and T2 AUROC is 0.693–0.785, with masked-support concordance of 0.699 and audited weighted T1 AUROC of 0.706–0.760.

OEVjA7427h.one_liner: Associative lookup and sequence continuation define two read types whose full-attention calls can each share a KV cache.
OEVjA7427h.problem: Hybrid attention models lack a clear account of how much exact-retrieval state can be shared across full-attention layers.
OEVjA7427h.method: The framework models full attention as associative-memory reads and writes, separating identity-based lookup from predecessor-window-based continuation. Reads of each type share a key function, and a role-stability premise makes two layers necessary.
OEVjA7427h.key_idea: Share one key function and KV cache among lookup reads and another among continuation reads, varying queries within each type.
OEVjA7427h.evidence: The framework analyzes direct, chained, and multi-target retrieval, and experiments on 0.5B and 1.3B hybrids test role specialization and continuation-group merging.

pvEZO0Mdu1.one_liner: Separate historical KV views and a fast visual adapter combine long-term memory with frequent action replanning.
pvEZO0Mdu1.problem: Long-horizon robot policies must remember past cues and track moving objects without repeatedly paying for full VLM updates.
pvEZO0Mdu1.method: D^2-VLA incrementally caches observations and builds separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter inserts fresh visual features into the latest KV block and a short fast-memory queue supports replanning.
pvEZO0Mdu1.key_idea: Separate VLM and action-expert history reads while injecting fresh visual features between periodic VLM updates for faster replanning.
pvEZO0Mdu1.evidence: Evaluation uses DOMINO, the introduced ten-task DOMINO-Long benchmark, eight real-robot tasks, LIBERO-Long, and RoboTwin 2.0.
pvEZO0Mdu1.claimed_gains: D^2-VLA reaches 29.3% success on DOMINO versus 9.6% for pi_0.5 and 17.2% for PUMA, 60.0% on DOMINO-Long versus 35.4% and 20.6%, respectively, and 97.5% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3% on RoboTwin 2.0.

aQyQE02j4O.one_liner: Degrading visual-text attention creates a weak prediction that steers diffusion samples toward the text condition.
aQyQE02j4O.problem: Existing training-free perturbation guidance mostly refines visual structure and yields limited gains when text alignment is the main bottleneck.
aQyQE02j4O.method: Text attention guidance perturbs attention weights between visual and textual tokens to produce a prediction with weaker conditioning alignment. Sampling extrapolates away from that prediction to target the text-conditioning bottleneck.
aQyQE02j4O.key_idea: Degrade visual-text attention to construct a weak conditional prediction, then guide sampling away from it.
aQyQE02j4O.evidence: Experiments cover U-Net and transformer diffusion models, including SDXL, SD3.5, Flux.1-dev, and Qwen-Image.

LlqSEKQGCG.one_liner: A critic filters observations into an evidence ledger that guides multimodal planning and supplies training trajectories.
LlqSEKQGCG.problem: Noisy multimodal observations accumulate in agent histories and disrupt multi-step planning.
LlqSEKQGCG.method: Omni-Decision replaces growing dialogue histories with a ledger of missing, confirmed, and conflicting evidence. A critic admits usable observations, and recorded state-action-verdict trajectories support supervised fine-tuning and decision-level reinforcement learning.
LlqSEKQGCG.key_idea: Filter observations through a critic into an explicit evidence ledger, then plan from that compact state.
LlqSEKQGCG.evidence: Controlled planner and perception-backend replacements diagnose the planning bottleneck, and evaluations use OmniGAIA and WorldSense.
LlqSEKQGCG.claimed_gains: Omni-Decision achieves 81.4% accuracy on OmniGAIA at approximately 43% of Gemini-3.1-Pro's cost per question and 65.0% on WorldSense.

0w5zXdvyJg.one_liner: Response timing annotations and a joint timeliness and precision metric support training and evaluation of proactive video agents.
0w5zXdvyJg.problem: Streaming video agents must respond promptly while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect outputs.
0w5zXdvyJg.method: PACE combines the PACE-780K annotated dataset with PAUC-F, a metric joining response timeliness and firing precision. It studies inference harnesses and training pipelines using sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured outputs.
0w5zXdvyJg.key_idea: Evaluate causal response decisions using both timeliness and firing precision, with streaming context maintained through visual windows and interaction memory.
0w5zXdvyJg.evidence: Experiments examine model-agnostic inference harnesses and training settings for offline VLMs, finding the strongest performance with visual windows, interaction memory, and structured outputs.

YevB0fjIul.one_liner: Pairwise aesthetic preferences within related image collections train an MLLM to judge photographs in context.
YevB0fjIul.problem: Independent image scoring and near-duplicate comparisons miss aesthetic preferences within broader contextually related photo collections.
YevB0fjIul.method: The paper introduces ContextAes-40K with within-collection preference pairs and ContextAes-Album with real-user rankings. ContextAes trains an MLLM-based aesthetic model through three stages using the collection dataset.
YevB0fjIul.key_idea: Train aesthetic preferences from pairwise annotations among images sharing a scene, event, or subject.
YevB0fjIul.evidence: ContextAes-40K contains 39,033 images in 8,069 collections, and evaluation includes other aesthetic benchmarks and zero-shot testing on ContextAes-Album.

U5T7bpZuxX.one_liner: Synthesizes parametric CAD programs from point clouds by pairing MLLM construction planning with point segmentation and geometric fitting tools.
U5T7bpZuxX.problem: End-to-end multimodal LLMs compress point clouds into latent tokens and predict continuous CAD dimensions rather than measuring explicit 3D coordinates, leading to geometric errors.
U5T7bpZuxX.method: Query-and-Measure CAD (QM-CAD) uses an MLLM to draft a modeling plan and issue geometric queries to a point-cloud segmenter and geometry fitter, writing the final CAD program from returned parameter measurements and projections. The model is trained via supervised fine-tuning on synthesized tool-execution trajectories followed by reinforcement learning with solid Intersection-over-Union rewards.
U5T7bpZuxX.key_idea: Directs MLLM geometric queries to a surface-point segmenter and primitive fitter on raw 3D coordinates before writing executable CAD code, refined with solid-IoU RL.
U5T7bpZuxX.evidence: Trained via supervised fine-tuning on automatically synthesized plan-measure-generate trajectories with real tool executions followed by solid-IoU reinforcement learning.

mFc5hb2xgq.one_liner: Generates editable graphic layouts iteratively by planning, rendering, and visually verifying functional element groups on an evolving canvas.
mFc5hb2xgq.problem: Existing iterative MLLM graphic-design generators fix high-level layout plans before execution, preventing dynamic adaptation as the rendered composition evolves.
mFc5hb2xgq.method: PlayGround initializes generation with a Structure-Aware Retriever that fetches structurally similar reference designs from unordered elements, then runs a progressive loop of a Progressive Planner, Layout Generator, and Visual Verifier. At each turn, the planner inspects the rendered canvas and remaining elements to plan the next functional group, the generator predicts editable attributes, and the verifier guides visual refinement.
mFc5hb2xgq.key_idea: Iteratively groups unordered design elements, predicts editable layout attributes, and verifies rendered candidates turn-by-turn against the evolving canvas with structure-aware reference retrieval.
mFc5hb2xgq.evidence: Supported by a two-stage data generation pipeline extracting functional groups and turn-level step-wise supervision for the Progressive Planner.

MiONXSc1yq.one_liner: Cancels unstable forward-reverse self-consistency forces and applies adaptive restoration via aggregation-first reward tilting for diffusion reinforcement learning.
MiONXSc1yq.problem: Reverse-process diffusion RL suffers from local exploration and weak credit assignment, while forward-process reward tuning is destabilized by a hidden forward-reverse self-consistency force.
MiONXSc1yq.method: DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting) analytically cancels the destabilizing self-consistency force in forward-process diffusion fine-tuning and introduces adaptive restoration gradients with minimal hyperparameter tuning. The formulation also supports pairwise preference reward models through DiffusionART-Pairwise.
MiONXSc1yq.key_idea: Systematically cancels the destabilizing forward-reverse self-consistency force in forward-process diffusion reward tuning while applying adaptive restoration gradients through aggregation-first reward tilting.
MiONXSc1yq.evidence: Supported by analytical and empirical stability analyses and experiments across text-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video generation, including HunyuanVideo-13B against DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast.
MiONXSc1yq.claimed_gains: On HunyuanVideo-13B text-to-video generation, matches the plateau training rewards of DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast with 11.19x and 11.23x fewer GPU hours, respectively.

3PfwNO8xjY.one_liner: Generates handwritten mathematical expressions without spatial annotations by conditioning a latent Diffusion Transformer on MathML-derived relational syntax triplets.
3PfwNO8xjY.problem: Handwritten mathematical expression generators typically require explicit spatial layout supervision to model 2D hierarchical structures, incurring high annotation costs.
3PfwNO8xjY.method: DiffMath distills LaTeX/MathML trees into Relational Abstract Syntax Tree (RelAST) triplet sequences encoding symbol identities, spatial relations, and nesting depths, and trains MathVAE with symbol- and relation-aware perceptual regularization. MathDiT then denoises latents conditioned on RelAST and guided via Adaptive Layer Normalization by a global symbol-count prior.
3PfwNO8xjY.key_idea: Encodes MathML trees into symbol-relation-depth triplets to condition a symbol-count-guided Diffusion Transformer operating in a relation-regularized VAE latent space.
3PfwNO8xjY.evidence: Evaluated on handwritten mathematical expression generation without explicit positional supervision.

amDra4fgO6.one_liner: Trains a state-conditioned actor to select hyperspherical latent inputs for frozen RL diffusion policies during robot deployment.
amDra4fgO6.problem: Independently resampling prior noise at every control step in RL-trained diffusion policies introduces temporal action inconsistency, high-frequency jitter, body sway, and trajectory dispersion on physical robots.
amDra4fgO6.method: SteerGenPO freezes the RL-trained diffusion policy and trains an actor conditioned on robot state and task command to select latent inputs parameterized by angular coordinates on a sphere of radius √D. At deployment, the actor deterministically outputs mean angular coordinates to steer latent behaviors smoothly.
amDra4fgO6.key_idea: Freezes the RL-trained diffusion generator and trains a state-conditioned actor to deterministically select latent inputs constrained via angular coordinates to a √D-radius sphere.
amDra4fgO6.evidence: Evaluated against random latent sampling on simulated robot control benchmarks, Unitree G1 locomotion and path tracking, and physical-robot experiments.

G7rvcLSHoN.one_liner: Projects cross-attention value vectors onto the null space of ghost-augmented negated concepts for training-free text-to-image negation.
G7rvcLSHoN.problem: Text-to-image models struggle with logical negation because negative prompting fails when negated and contextual concepts strongly co-occur, while fine-tuning is costly.
G7rvcLSHoN.method: This plug-in module projects contextual components in cross-attention value vectors onto the semantic null space of negated concepts without retraining, paired with ghost token augmentation to expand the negated semantic subspace.
G7rvcLSHoN.key_idea: Project contextual cross-attention value vectors onto the null space of negated semantics expanded with ghost token augmentation without retraining.
G7rvcLSHoN.evidence: Tested on generation tasks including a newly constructed Negation Benchmark with mixed positive and negated prompts against open-source baselines and Nano Banana Flash.

jWVtjqUy7y.one_liner: Pairs an agent managing revisable structural search hypotheses with an execution module running specialized high-dimensional Bayesian optimizers.
jWVtjqUy7y.problem: Existing LLM-based and agentic Bayesian optimization methods become unreliable in high-dimensional settings where useful objective structure and appropriate search geometry are unknown.
jWVtjqUy7y.method: HERA manages and updates revisable search hypotheses from observed structural evidence and task metadata, while PRISM executes specialized high-dimensional Bayesian optimizers selected under those hypotheses.
jWVtjqUy7y.key_idea: Maintain and revise explicit hypotheses over unknown objective structure and search geometry to select and configure specialized high-dimensional Bayesian optimizers.
jWVtjqUy7y.evidence: Evaluated on metadata-free synthetic functions and diverse real-world high-dimensional optimization benchmarks against classical HDBO and LLM-based/agentic baselines, with ablations on metadata and decision frequency.

sU241eLnbY.one_liner: Reconstructs compiled AMDGPU binaries for agentic profile-guided assembly editing verified against captured launch behavior.
sU241eLnbY.problem: Source-level LLM kernel optimizers cannot optimize compiled GPU binaries whose editable high-level source is unavailable, autogenerated, or far removed from final machine instructions.
sU241eLnbY.method: Given a compiled AMDGPU code object, AsmEvo reconstructs a reassemblable assembly representation, applies profile-guided edits via a long-horizon agent, and rebuilds ABI-preserving binaries or conservative in-place patches. Candidate binaries are accepted only if they pass capture-scoped functional equivalence and paired validation against the original binary in a persistent evaluator.
sU241eLnbY.key_idea: Disassemble compiled AMDGPU code objects into reassemblable representations, apply profile-guided agentic edits, and accept candidates passing capture-scoped equivalence checks.
sU241eLnbY.evidence: Evaluated on 30 KernelBench kernels on AMD MI308X and on production AITER binaries and vLLM/SGLang Triton assembly kernels on AMD MI300X.
sU241eLnbY.claimed_gains: Improves all 30 selected KernelBench kernels on MI308X with 1.41x geometric-mean and 3.53x maximum speedup, and reaches 1.12x/1.33x and 1.49x/2.08x geometric-mean/maximum speedups on MI300X AITER binaries and vLLM/SGLang Triton kernels, respectively.

LROoOJsmv1.one_liner: Routes fixed-budget egocentric video evidence by tracking unresolved query relations on a transient demand graph before frozen task-head inference.
LROoOJsmv1.problem: Relevance- and diversity-based frame selectors in long-horizon egocentric video can spend limited evidence budgets on redundant observations while leaving required multi-step query relations unsupported.
LROoOJsmv1.method: EgoSCOPE represents query requirements as a transient Query Demand Graph over semantic relation categories and uses a lightweight recurrent set encoder to track relation support, conflict, and marginal closure. It prioritizes observations resolving unsatisfied demands while suppressing redundant or conflicting evidence prior to a single frozen task-head call.
LROoOJsmv1.key_idea: Recurrently update relation support and conflict over a query-specific demand graph to select evidence maximizing marginal closure under a fixed budget.
LROoOJsmv1.evidence: Evaluated under fixed evidence budgets across Ego4D NLQ, EgoLifeQA, and VSI-Bench with full-list task evaluations and matched selector controls.

WMrH0XOdsL.one_liner: Distills contrastive logits between safety-prompted and knowledge-prompted passes of a reasoning LLM into its unconditional weights via co-evolving targets.
WMrH0XOdsL.problem: Output-level machine unlearning leaves a reasoning model's unconditional chain-of-thought generation intact or degrades benign utility, allowing hazardous knowledge reconstruction inside thinking traces.
WMrH0XOdsL.method: Self-Projection Distilled Unlearning (SPDU) computes contrastive logits between safety-prompted and knowledge-prompted forward passes of the model and distills them into unconditional model weights using a target that co-evolves with the student during training.
WMrH0XOdsL.key_idea: Distill contrastive logits between safety-prompted and knowledge-prompted forward passes into model weights using a target that co-evolves with the student.
WMrH0XOdsL.evidence: Supported by an inference-time contrastive decoding analysis on reasoning models, while full benchmark details are truncated in the abstract.

Ym4aJ9You7.one_liner: Propagates sparse manual 9D canonical object poses across multi-view video point clouds to build a 22.8M-image real-world pose dataset.
Ym4aJ9You7.problem: Single-image 9D object pose estimation lacks large-scale real-world supervision because prior datasets rely on synthetic renderings or cover few real object categories.
Ym4aJ9You7.method: Every9D-22M reconstructs object-level point clouds from 114K object-centric videos via multi-view geometry, aligns instances into shared canonical frames from manual labels on under 0.01% of images, and verifies propagated poses across multiple views. It also defines cross-category orientation rules for symmetry-aware evaluation.
Ym4aJ9You7.key_idea: Reconstruct object point clouds from videos and align instances to propagate sparse manual canonical pose annotations with multi-view verification and symmetry rules.
Ym4aJ9You7.evidence: Constructs 22.8M real-world 9D-annotated images across 630 everyday categories with dedicated benchmark splits and cross-dataset generalization experiments.

4jr0qkxVQ4.one_liner: Generates reduced-noise surrogate training samples for Bayesian optimization by interpolating evaluated observations with complementary local deviations.
4jr0qkxVQ4.problem: Surrogate fitting in Bayesian optimization degrades under observation noise, and existing remedies focus on surrogate or acquisition design rather than mitigating noise at the observation data level.
4jr0qkxVQ4.method: RoSF-BO uses local functional relationships among already evaluated solutions to pair observations exhibiting complementary noise deviations and generates synthetic low-noise training samples via residual-cancellation interpolation without extra objective evaluations.
4jr0qkxVQ4.key_idea: Identify evaluated points with complementary noise deviations via local functional relationships and interpolate them to synthesize lower-noise surrogate training data.
4jr0qkxVQ4.evidence: Supported by theoretical noise-reduction analysis and experiments on static datasets, noisy single-objective BO, and noisy multi-objective BO across multiple BO algorithms and noise distributions.

E4vog7t7dY.one_liner: Routes vision-language evidence coarsely through text-derived semantic prototype families and finely via full-query prototype weighting.
E4vog7t7dY.problem: Query-conditioned vision-language models entangle object-level visual evidence with co-occurring objects and scene context, and exposed attribution maps often diverge from prediction-driving features.
E4vog7t7dY.method: ProtoLIP inserts a lightweight prototype-mediated evidence layer that groups reusable visual prototypes into text-derived semantic families to constrain coarse eligibility before computing fine-grained prototype contributions from the complete query.
E4vog7t7dY.key_idea: Organize visual prototypes into text-derived semantic families that gate eligibility before computing fine-grained query-conditioned prototype contributions.
E4vog7t7dY.evidence: Evaluated across four object- and phrase-level out-of-distribution benchmarks and tested for zero-shot localization transfer across independently pretrained VLMs.
E4vog7t7dY.claimed_gains: ProtoLIP achieves average relative improvements of 29% in Pointing and 43% in Energy across four object- and phrase-level out-of-distribution benchmarks.

C7aiJDjwk5.one_liner: Counterfactual context pairs guide few-shot distillation for open-book question answering.
C7aiJDjwk5.problem: Few-shot distillation is highly sensitive to training-sample choice, and uncertain samples near the teacher decision boundary can degrade it.
C7aiJDjwk5.method: COFFEQA minimally modifies contexts to induce alternative teacher answers and uses factual-counterfactual pairs as additional supervision. Context Following Difficulty validates counterfactuals before distillation based on agreement with the intended alternative answer.
C7aiJDjwk5.key_idea: Constrain teacher-student decision-boundary deviation using minimally changed contexts paired with their original factual examples.
C7aiJDjwk5.evidence: Geometric analysis motivates factual-counterfactual supervision, and the Context Following Difficulty metric validates counterfactuals before distillation.

HlDHyZFr4O.one_liner: Heuristic turn-level credit and on-policy branching replay improve multi-turn reasoning optimization.
HlDHyZFr4O.problem: Multi-turn reinforcement learning suffers from sparse terminal rewards, ambiguous trajectory credit, and mismatch between fixed replays and the evolving policy.
HlDHyZFr4O.method: HBR-GRPO evaluates each action by its reduction in heuristic distance to the answer, decomposing trajectory training into turns. On-policy branching replay reconnects turn examples using transitions generated by the current policy.
HlDHyZFr4O.key_idea: Assign turn-level credit by heuristic-distance reduction and reconnect turns through current-policy branching replay.
HlDHyZFr4O.evidence: Experiments evaluate HBR-GRPO with Qwen3-8B across multi-turn interactive reasoning tasks and include a clembench leaderboard comparison.

KaVkDAN1LH.one_liner: Structured per-source cards expose detection, timing, and attribute errors in polyphonic audio captions.
KaVkDAN1LH.problem: Single free-text caption scores cannot localize omissions, source conflation, or misassigned attributes in multi-source audio understanding.
KaVkDAN1LH.method: MixCardsBench first evaluates source identification and temporal localization, then structured MixCards describing each source's semantic, temporal, and acoustic properties. It provides source-level reference cards for ecologically plausible synthetic soundscapes.
KaVkDAN1LH.key_idea: Evaluate separate source-level semantic, temporal, and acoustic fields instead of only an aggregate free-text caption.
KaVkDAN1LH.evidence: Seven large audio language models are evaluated on 4884 synthetic soundscapes with up to eight overlapping speech, music, and sound-effects sources.
KaVkDAN1LH.claimed_gains: The strongest model reaches only around 60% mean card-field score.

pUyqFOA6em.one_liner: Partial information decomposition measures repetitive reasoning from redundant answer-relevant information across steps.
pUyqFOA6em.problem: Large reasoning models produce lengthy, repetitive, or erroneous reasoning trajectories that require process-level quality measures.
pUyqFOA6em.method: SLIDER decomposes answer information between consecutive reasoning steps into unique, redundant, and synergistic components. Step-RRI measures redundancy relative to new contributions, while Trajectory-RRI aggregates repetitiveness over a trajectory.
pUyqFOA6em.key_idea: Quantify repetition as the share of current-step answer information redundant with preceding steps rather than unique or synergistic.
pUyqFOA6em.evidence: SLIDER is applied to the redundancy class of PRMBench and compared with embedding-similarity and information-gain baselines for step-level redundancy identification.
pUyqFOA6em.claimed_gains: Step-RRI improves step-level redundancy identification accuracy by over 10 points compared to embedding-similarity and information-gain baselines.

rC6WLmT8Uz.one_liner: Generative reasoning programs adapt verifiable visual questions to policy ability and evaluation difficulty.
rC6WLmT8Uz.problem: Static visual datasets bind images to fixed questions whose learning value varies across models and can decline during training.
rC6WLmT8Uz.method: VisualReasoningGym converts static datasets and metadata into programs that factor questions into grounded atomic skills and verifiable reasoning operations. It samples atomic questions and composes their answers through aggregation, affine, shortest-path, and combinatorial-optimization programs.
rC6WLmT8Uz.key_idea: Generate questions at training or evaluation time by composing grounded atomic skills with parametric verifiable reasoning programs.
rC6WLmT8Uz.evidence: Experiments identify declining learning signal in static datasets and motivate policy-matched training questions and increasingly difficult evaluation until model failure.

CXMg1fT34J.one_liner: Causal evidence budgeting jointly retains streaming visual evidence and retrieves question-relevant context.
CXMg1fT34J.problem: Early fixed retention decisions can discard visual evidence needed by future questions, making later retrieval unable to recover it.
CXMg1fT34J.method: StreamingRETAKE allocates visual-token capacity toward informative frames, jointly selects shared KV evidence after more frames arrive, and retrieves using evidence importance and question relevance. The training-free framework bounds visual-history storage and answer contexts.
CXMg1fT34J.key_idea: Delay joint evidence retention until more frames arrive and combine evidence importance with question relevance at retrieval.
CXMg1fT34J.evidence: Experiments evaluate real-time streaming video understanding on OVO-Bench Real-Time and StreamingBench real-Time under bounded memory and context.
CXMg1fT34J.claimed_gains: StreamingRETAKE achieves 75.52% accuracy on OVO-Bench Real-Time and 81.80% on StreamingBench real-Time.

XPRucpRJls.one_liner: Studies a simple Lean 4 verifier-feedback agentic loop (h1) for test-time scaling in formal theorem proving.
XPRucpRJls.problem: Formal theorem proving increasingly relies on complex human-designed planning and decomposition workflows whose gains are often confounded with stronger models or extra compute.
XPRucpRJls.method: They build h1, a minimal harness giving an LLM an efficient Lean 4 interface with verifier feedback and self-reflection, without imposing search or decomposition structure.
XPRucpRJls.key_idea: Runs an unconstrained LLM self-reflection loop directly against an efficient Lean 4 verifier interface at test time.
XPRucpRJls.evidence: Evaluated on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, with matched-model comparisons and ablations against Goedel-Architect, AlphaProof Nexus, Claude Code, and AxProverBase.
XPRucpRJls.claimed_gains: Settles eight open problems in FormalConjectures and matches or outperforms Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus at matched models, while exact numeric scores are not stated.

NfRHzaMDLH.one_liner: Shows network width degrades HAPPO via larger realized policy updates, and lowering learning rate restores performance.
NfRHzaMDLH.problem: Increasing network capacity in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning can unexpectedly degrade policy performance in algorithms like HAPPO.
NfRHzaMDLH.method: They run a four-way identification study crossing sequential versus synchronous updates with independent versus shared parameters, and intervene on learning rates to match realized policy KL.
NfRHzaMDLH.key_idea: Matches wider networks' realized policy-update KL displacement to small-network baselines by scaling down the learning rate.
NfRHzaMDLH.evidence: Experiments on SMACv2 protoss 5 vs 5 over five seeds comparing HAPPO and MAPPO across hidden sizes 64 and 256.
NfRHzaMDLH.claimed_gains: Increasing HAPPO hidden size from 64 to 256 reduces win rate from 0.474 to 0.368 over five seeds on SMACv2 protoss 5 vs 5, and lowering the learning rate shrinks the capacity gap.

amQWsBIObs.one_liner: Diagnoses why RL-trained VLM crop-and-zoom tools behave decoratively via pixel-budget gates and counterfactual credit.
amQWsBIObs.problem: RL-trained vision-language models often localize accurately with crop-and-zoom tools yet gain little causal information from the returned crops.
amQWsBIObs.method: The authors analyze three bottlenecks—working pixel-budget gates, additive tool-call serialization costs, and outcome-based RL credit assignment—and introduce a counterfactual credit measure for genuine tool use.
amQWsBIObs.key_idea: Measures genuine visual tool use via counterfactual credit while isolating pixel-budget saturation and tool-call serialization losses.
amQWsBIObs.evidence: Experiments measure crop value across datasets, working pixel budgets, MME-RealWorld-Lite, DocVQA, and 16 Qwen dataset-by-budget comparisons.
amQWsBIObs.claimed_gains: Perfect-crop value rises monotonically from +5.8 to +31.1 points as pixel budgets tighten, while plain second images improve all 16 Qwen comparisons by +6.8 to +17.3 points.

PYtDhvW0nV.one_liner: Shows hyperbolic VLMs operate in a near-Euclidean regime and proposes a simpler Euclidean hierarchy-aware VLM that outperforms them.
PYtDhvW0nV.problem: Hyperbolic vision-language models intend to use entailment cones for hierarchical alignment, yet their embeddings cluster near the origin on low-curvature manifolds outside valid cone domains.
PYtDhvW0nV.method: The authors diagnose why existing hyperbolic VLMs operate near Euclidean space and propose a Euclidean hierarchy-aware VLM that retains the same compositional data and hierarchical supervision while removing hyperbolic operations and entailment cones.
PYtDhvW0nV.key_idea: Replacing hyperbolic geometry and entailment cones with Euclidean representations under identical compositional supervision isolates whether gains come from supervision rather than geometry.
PYtDhvW0nV.evidence: Empirical diagnosis of embedding geometry in existing hyperbolic VLMs and downstream task comparisons against the proposed Euclidean hierarchy-aware VLM.

lVAk9WoqGf.one_liner: Generates and edits First-Order Ambisonics spatial audio via executable scene plans, an FOA VAE, and on-policy self-distillation.
lVAk9WoqGf.problem: Multi-source spatial audio generation and editing require fine-grained control over source semantics, timing, and 3D trajectories while preserving unmodified acoustics.
lVAk9WoqGf.method: AMBIT uses an executable ScenePlan binding source descriptions to activity intervals and 3D trajectories on a unified Transfusion backbone combining autoregressive planning with rectified-flow rendering. It introduces an FOA-aware continuous VAE with spatial covariance matching and refines both planning and rendering via Transfusion-tailored on-policy self-distillation using target-conditioned teacher predictions.
