lVAk9WoqGf.key_idea: Pairs an executable ScenePlan and FOA-aware continuous VAE on a Transfusion backbone with target-conditioned on-policy self-distillation for spatial audio.
lVAk9WoqGf.evidence: Evaluated across speech, music, and sound scenes for generation content, spatial quality, and acoustic fidelity against baselines.

J8bLePxnBR.one_liner: Generates energy-based model negatives via a random auxiliary label before conditioning on the target label.
J8bLePxnBR.problem: Short-run MCMC samplers from random noise in deep energy-based models remain initialization-dependent and cover only limited modes of each class.
J8bLePxnBR.method: Relay sampling runs a joint energy model first under a random auxiliary class label to form a structured intermediate state, then continues sampling under the target class label.
J8bLePxnBR.key_idea: Uses random auxiliary-class conditioning to create cross-label warm starts that diversify finite-step MCMC paths from noise to target classes.
J8bLePxnBR.evidence: Evaluations on ImageNet 64x64 and ImageNet 256x256 with a pixel-space ConvNeXt-Large model, plus classification, OOD detection, and calibration checks.
J8bLePxnBR.claimed_gains: On ImageNet 256x256, relay training of a pixel-space ConvNeXt-Large model from random noise yields an FID of 3.05, below diffusion and autoregressive baselines using 1.6 to 3 times as many parameters.

Ii6ssZR5UN.one_liner: Uses a frozen VLM as a relational world model to predict future scene relation graphs along candidate navigation frontiers.
Ii6ssZR5UN.problem: Zero-shot object navigation methods model goals as single categories and fail on instructions specifying relational constraints among entities.
Ii6ssZR5UN.method: RWMNav parses instructions into a relational goal graph, builds an environmental relation graph from RGB-D inputs, and prompts a frozen VLM to predict future relation graphs at candidate frontiers for goal-compatibility matching.
Ii6ssZR5UN.key_idea: Predicts future environmental relation graphs at exploration frontiers using a training-free frozen VLM and matches them against a parsed relational goal graph.

ZbdDq0vP6G.one_liner: Enables agents to recursively revise and hot-reload their own harnesses during long-running optimization without reference solutions.
ZbdDq0vP6G.problem: Offline harness optimization relies on reference answers and may fail to address new difficulties encountered during long-running tasks.
ZbdDq0vP6G.method: The authors introduce the PerfRace benchmark for reference-free software performance optimization and BoxBox, a system supporting agent-triggered harness revision with kernel-managed hot reloading that preserves execution context.
ZbdDq0vP6G.key_idea: Allows an agent to trigger harness revisions from task-specific experience and hot-reload them via kernel management while preserving execution context.
ZbdDq0vP6G.evidence: Evaluated on PerfRace under matched test-time budgets against Frozen Harness, offline Harness Evolution, and Harness Scaling.
ZbdDq0vP6G.claimed_gains: Reaches a 4h speedup of 1.70x compared with 1.54x for the strongest baseline.

dywDPdGuwh.one_liner: Uses fixed task-derived object or camera-ray queries to retrieve spatial scene memory during visuospatial video generation.
dywDPdGuwh.problem: Visuospatial video generation methods condition on scene observations without explicitly retrieving task-relevant scene evidence for each output token.
dywDPdGuwh.method: SceneQuery builds global and spatial memory from RGB observations and generates fixed queries per output token from target-object semantics and coordinates (for grounding) or camera rays (for navigation). Memory and retrieval are trained end-to-end via the video generation loss without 3D reconstruction.
dywDPdGuwh.key_idea: Derives fixed denoising-invariant retrieval queries from target-object semantics or camera rays to fetch relevant spatial memory for each output video token.
dywDPdGuwh.evidence: Evaluated on ScanNet++ for camera-trajectory navigation and object grounding against a matched context-guided baseline.
dywDPdGuwh.claimed_gains: Selected configurations improve target-view reconstruction for navigation and reduce geometric error for grounding on ScanNet++ (exact numbers not stated in abstract).

tic76oBPmy.one_liner: Quantifies the timescale separation between Adam's gradient-like update transition and Euclidean-margin convergence in linear classification.
tic76oBPmy.problem: In separable linear classification with small stability constant epsilon, it is unclear when Adam transitions from max-norm-margin behavior to Euclidean-margin optimality.
tic76oBPmy.method: The paper analyzes deterministic, full-batch, bias-corrected Adam under softmax log-loss with polynomially or inverse-linearly decaying stepsizes. It derives iteration bounds for when updates become gradient-like versus when the classifier reaches a target Euclidean margin.
tic76oBPmy.key_idea: Derives asymptotic iteration bounds showing Adam's updates turn gradient-like in polylogarithmic/polynomial steps while Euclidean-margin convergence requires inverse-polynomial/exponential steps in epsilon.
tic76oBPmy.evidence: Theoretical convergence bounds for 1/3 < a < 1 and a = 1 stepsize decay schedules, supported by experiments.
tic76oBPmy.claimed_gains: Updates become gradient-like after Theta(log(1/epsilon)^(1/(1-a))) iterations, while reaching target Euclidean margin requires epsilon^(-Theta(1)/(1-a)) iterations (for 1/3 < a < 1).

CDCbGzutM3.one_liner: Learns distinct component-wise coefficients in a fixed task-orthogonal spectral basis to match expert predictions during model merging.
CDCbGzutM3.problem: Cross-task orthogonalization removes weight-space overlap when merging experts, yet merged models still produce predictions that diverge from individual task experts.
CDCbGzutM3.method: The authors jointly learn component-wise scalar coefficients for retained spectral components within a fixed, task-structured orthogonal basis by matching individual expert predictions on unlabeled calibration inputs without changing component directions.
CDCbGzutM3.key_idea: Learns component-wise spectral coefficients in a fixed task-orthogonal basis by matching expert predictions on unlabeled calibration data.
CDCbGzutM3.evidence: Experiments across three CLIP backbones on 8, 14, and 20 tasks, plus MergeBench evaluations on base and instruction-tuned Llama-3.2-3B.
CDCbGzutM3.claimed_gains: On ViT-B/32, improves normalized accuracy over the strongest baseline by 3.2, 4.0, and 6.3 percentage points with 8, 14, and 20 tasks, respectively.

w3mFVq7KFH.one_liner: Learns stochastic population dynamics from unpaired marginals on state graphs by minimizing discrete kinetic energy via density ratios.
w3mFVq7KFH.problem: Learning population dynamics from unpaired temporal marginals is an ill-posed inverse problem requiring structural assumptions on the underlying state space.
w3mFVq7KFH.method: Discrete Action Matching (DAM) formulates a finite-state counterpart of Action Matching using discrete Wasserstein geometry on graphs. It derives an action-minimization objective from neighboring density ratios—estimated via interpolated histograms or sample-based local ratios—to learn an action potential defining a graph-supported Markov sampler.
w3mFVq7KFH.key_idea: Minimizes discrete kinetic-energy action on state graphs using neighboring density ratios to learn a potential-driven Markov sampler.
w3mFVq7KFH.evidence: Experiments on controlled synthetic and real dynamics datasets evaluating marginal reconstruction and interpolation.

QBvPMEK8Vf.one_liner: Automates relational SQL feature search using schema-typed compilation, paired multi-context block feedback, and a protected final selector.
QBvPMEK8Vf.problem: LLM agents searching over SQL for relational feature engineering face invalid queries, noisy full-program credit assignment, and overfitting during final predictor selection.
QBvPMEK8Vf.method: RelCraft enforces executable, row-aligned SQL via a schema-typed grammar and point-in-time verifier, evaluates feature blocks by comparing paired contexts with and without each block under fixed folds and seeds, and selects the final frozen SQL-predictor pair on a protected split with a complexity prior.
QBvPMEK8Vf.key_idea: Separates SQL feature search into schema-typed point-in-time compilation, paired multi-context block credit evaluation, and protected-split final selection.
QBvPMEK8Vf.evidence: Evaluated on 32 tasks across three relational benchmark suites, common-harness comparisons against RelAgent, and a finite-sample loss bound for the protected selector.
QBvPMEK8Vf.claimed_gains: Lowers SQL failure rate from 6.6% to 2.0%, reduces the protected-test gap from 1.31 to 0.56 points, and selects 32% fewer feature blocks against RelAgent.

cBn7myuWYC.one_liner: Closure-terminated equation-graph retrieval produces scenario cards that generate and verify interactive physics simulations and videos.
cBn7myuWYC.problem: Generated simulations and videos may look plausible while violating the physical laws stated in a scientific document.
cBn7myuWYC.method: The method represents documents as graphs of equations, quantities, and validity regimes, retrieving until equations form a closed solvable system. A physics scenario card records dynamics and controllable ranges, drives generation, and supplies document-derived behavior tests.
cBn7myuWYC.key_idea: Use one closure-checked physics scenario card as both the generation specification and source of document-grounded verification tests.
cBn7myuWYC.evidence: Evaluation on 45 held-out figures compares closure-terminated retrieval with similarity search and single-call generation, measures physics and interaction accuracy, and checks video motion against document-derived closed forms.
cBn7myuWYC.claimed_gains: On 45 held-out figures, the artifacts reach 80% physics accuracy against 42% for single-call generation and 63% interaction accuracy against 45%.

kHMXjTETxs.one_liner: Canonical evidence-unit grouping removes stored-row multiplicity effects while preserving genuine repeated annotations.
kHMXjTETxs.problem: Duplicated stored rows can alter weak temporal learning without adding evidence, while genuinely repeated annotation acts may have identical content.
kHMXjTETxs.method: Quotient learning compiles rows into canonically grouped evidence units before applying the existing learning pipeline. The study compares acquisition/type normalization, content deduplication, inverse weighting, identity compilation, and unequal-copy replays.
kHMXjTETxs.key_idea: Fit the learning pipeline on canonical evidence units so storage copies cannot change risk weighting or validation while genuine repetition remains.
kHMXjTETxs.evidence: Experiments cover seven temporal datasets, fivefold storage duplication, native repeated judgments on G-Eval and Indeterminacy, a public-export audit, and unequal-copy replays.
kHMXjTETxs.claimed_gains: Preserving sampled-act frequencies lowers held-out judgment log loss by 12.21% on G-Eval and 7.05% on a separate Indeterminacy release against the strongest tested content competitors.

v0QwBx5Edr.one_liner: Coverage and neighbor-failure priors deterministically recommend under-tested driving-condition slices for VLM evaluation.
v0QwBx5Edr.problem: Sparse driving-VLM verification leaves many operational-design-domain slices untested and their empirical failure rates unreliable.
v0QwBx5Edr.method: SliceScorer combines an exposure-based coverage prior with a neighbor-failure prior. SliceNav lets an LLM interpret developer queries and compose triage, scoring, acquisition, evaluation, and vocabulary-extension operators while keeping scoring deterministic.
v0QwBx5Edr.key_idea: Rank missing slices by under-exposure and risk propagated from similar tested conditions without delegating scores to the LLM.
v0QwBx5Edr.evidence: Experiments on WiseAD, DriveMM, and Cosmos-Reason2-2B compare failure-risk capture and recommendation diversity across testing budgets, with component ablations and qualitative workflows.

64gLvkbg9D.one_liner: Shared world programs and validated repair histories turn construction experience into reusable embodied-world generation knowledge.
64gLvkbg9D.problem: Executable-world generation must reuse successful builds and repairs while preserving relations between object mechanisms and spatial context.
64gLvkbg9D.method: VibeArena coordinates multiple agents through a shared world program linking layout, geometry, articulation, physical properties, and tasks. Execution feedback guides revisions, while validated templates, conditional repair rules, and scheduling policies are refined or retired as cross-scene evidence accumulates.
64gLvkbg9D.key_idea: Consolidate validated builds and repairs into reusable templates, conditional rules, and inspection schedules tied to a shared world program.
64gLvkbg9D.evidence: Experiments assess object and scene generation quality, physical stability, and downstream tasks, accompanied by visual examples of scenes and articulated assets.

zTYfRpjTNh.one_liner: Response-position certificates certify feasible coordinated decisions despite objectives hidden behind error-bounded queries.
zTYfRpjTNh.problem: A coordinator paying for error-bounded allocation responses cannot observe party objectives, making feasible joint decisions and their certification information-limited.
zTYfRpjTNh.method: The paper constructs coupled strongly convex two-world instances and derives minimax-regret, query, state, and ambiguity bounds. It then certifies candidates from response positions, public smoothness, and local error bounds without fitting objectives.
zTYfRpjTNh.key_idea: Certify feasibility directly from response positions and local error bounds rather than attempting to reconstruct hidden objectives.
zTYfRpjTNh.evidence: Theory includes adaptive queries and unlimited memory, while quadratic, log-cosh, and coupled nonlinear studies compare position and recovery-based certificates on identical transcripts.
zTYfRpjTNh.claimed_gains: On identical transcripts and recovered averages, the position certificate verifies target accuracy after a mean of 8.6 and 20.3 high-fidelity calls for quadratic and log-cosh objectives, while neither recovery-based certificate does so within 512 calls.

BvcY70xdA5.one_liner: Curriculum RLVR on inexpensive synthetic molecular tasks transfers design strategies to costly lead optimization.
BvcY70xdA5.problem: Chemically relevant scoring functions can require hours or days per evaluation, making direct online RLVR for molecular design prohibitively expensive.
BvcY70xdA5.method: The study post-trains small open-weight LLMs with curriculum-based RLVR on synthetic design tasks that gradually become harder. It evaluates whether strategies learned from cheap tasks transfer to structure-based molecular lead optimization.
BvcY70xdA5.key_idea: Scale synthetic-task difficulty during RLVR so learned molecular design strategies transfer to expensive objectives unseen during online training.
BvcY70xdA5.evidence: Experiments compare curriculum-trained small open-weight models with much larger frontier models on structure-based lead optimization.

ebXV6loung.one_liner: Uses pairwise distance transformers and an FFN-free graph transformer to decompose pan-cancer tumor cell state-niche correlations.
ebXV6loung.problem: Existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models cannot jointly leverage single-cell spatial resolution and full-transcriptome coverage to explicitly and interpretably infer ligand-receptor cell-cell interaction mechanisms.
ebXV6loung.method: GITIII-scale combines transformers modeling cell pairs at defined spatial distances, an interpretable single-layer graph transformer without a feed-forward network to decompose sender-to-receiver gene effects, and a graph transformer producing cellular-neighborhood embeddings.
ebXV6loung.key_idea: A single-layer graph transformer without a feed-forward network decomposes how each neighboring sender cell influences each gene in a receiver cell alongside distance-aware pairwise transformers.
ebXV6loung.evidence: Trained on an assembled pan-cancer spatial transcriptomics dataset to model tumor microenvironment cell state-niche associations and ligand-receptor signaling.

PR15RERYzP.one_liner: Derives statistical convergence rates for estimating quadratic-cost optimal transport maps to multidimensional barycenters without map regularity assumptions.
PR15RERYzP.problem: Statistical estimation rates for algorithms that estimate optimal transport maps to a barycenter in continuous multidimensional Euclidean spaces remain largely unknown.
PR15RERYzP.method: The authors derive convergence rates for quadratic-cost optimal transport map estimation to the barycenter governed solely by the estimator class's approximation error (including deep neural networks), interpolating between fast rates under a Poincare inequality and slow general rates.
PR15RERYzP.key_idea: Bounding barycenter transport map estimation error solely by the estimator class approximation error without regularity assumptions interpolates between Poincare-inequality fast rates and general slow rates.
PR15RERYzP.evidence: Theoretical convergence-rate analysis under the quadratic cost in multidimensional Euclidean spaces.

Vinh0rXh96.one_liner: Over-draws training prompts and filters out likely zero-gradient groups before GRPO updates to curb spurious advantage.
Vinh0rXh96.problem: GRPO's within-group advantage assigns large magnitudes to guessed correct rollouts on bounded-answer tasks and wastes updates on all-correct or all-wrong zero-gradient groups.
Vinh0rXh96.method: Advantage Harness adds a prompt-selection layer that over-draws prompts at each update and retains those least likely to produce zero-gradient groups while keeping GRPO's advantage estimator and training rollout budget unchanged.
Vinh0rXh96.key_idea: Over-drawing prompts and selecting those least likely to yield zero-gradient rollout groups reshapes GRPO's input distribution without altering its reward-based advantage estimator.
Vinh0rXh96.evidence: Analysis on MATH-7.5K and multiple-choice prompts, plus RL experiments on Qwen2.5-0.5B across eight benchmarks against GRPO, a shuffled control, and a difficulty-label filter.
Vinh0rXh96.claimed_gains: On Qwen2.5-0.5B, Advantage Harness halves the zero-gradient rate and improves the eight-benchmark average over GRPO, a shuffled control, and a difficulty-label filter on every seed.

UPMcbVJlBi.one_liner: Fuses dual expert branches via scene-attribute graph aesthetic latent spaces to jointly generate quality descriptions and scores.
UPMcbVJlBi.problem: Decoupling image quality scoring from explanatory text generation breaks their causal link, whereas naively combining both in one sequence causes optimization conflicts and training instability.
UPMcbVJlBi.method: SAGA (Scene-Attribute Graphs based Aesthetic learning) fuses dual expert branches through their task-specific aesthetic experience latent spaces so a single model can unify description generation and quality scoring within one generation sequence.
UPMcbVJlBi.key_idea: Dual expert branches are fused through task-specific aesthetic experience latent spaces structured around scene-attribute graphs to couple description and score generation in one sequence.
UPMcbVJlBi.evidence: Experiments evaluating image description generation, quality scoring, reasoning capability, and inference latency against separately trained and existing methods.

XJN24IwYIH.one_liner: Trains sparse autoencoders on intermediate gene residual streams of Cell-to-Sentence-Scale models to interpret and steer biological features.
XJN24IwYIH.problem: It is unclear whether single-cell foundation models encode genuine biological knowledge or only subtle expression correlations with benchmark labels.
XJN24IwYIH.method: The authors train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on gene-level residual-stream activations across intermediate layers of Cell-to-Sentence-Scale models and evaluate the resulting feature dictionaries on reconstruction, downstream utility, Gene Ontology enrichment, and concept steering.
XJN24IwYIH.key_idea: Training sparse autoencoders on intermediate gene-level residual-stream activations extracts selective, nonredundant biological features whose semantics sharpen with layer depth and steer cell-type predictions.
XJN24IwYIH.evidence: Evaluated on two human peripheral blood mononuclear cell datasets using SAE reconstruction replacement, Gene Ontology enrichment analysis, distributional shift tests, and concept steering.

IhfNgJXxTT.one_liner: Distills trained MARL policies into compact local swarm rules and diagnoses compressibility via controlled follow-up tests.
IhfNgJXxTT.problem: Trained MARL policies are hard to interpret and may not preserve coordination across population sizes, and it is unclear when they can be compressed into local swarm laws.
IhfNgJXxTT.method: The authors evaluate compressing MARL teacher policies into compact local swarm laws across varied local information, rule grammars, fitting distributions, and deployment populations, using controlled follow-up tests to diagnose conversion failures.
IhfNgJXxTT.key_idea: Testing policy compression across controlled information boundaries, generic rule grammars, and population scales isolates local observability, rule expressivity, and cross-population stability as determinants of MARL compressibility.
IhfNgJXxTT.evidence: Experiments on a hidden-bit task, SMACv2 (Protoss and Terran with three compressors), pursuit, coverage, and public MPE Predator-Prey environments.
IhfNgJXxTT.claimed_gains: A 16-parameter pursuit law exceeds its teacher at training scale and remains effective up to 32x that population at constant density.

I8gk1yGgBf.one_liner: Introduces a synthetic fact-tracing benchmark and uses negative log-odds gradients to surface localized causal tokens in LM attribution.
I8gk1yGgBf.problem: Existing LM data attribution benchmarks vary multiple dataset factors at once, and standard cross-entropy gradient averaging dilutes localized causal evidence across long documents.
I8gk1yGgBf.method: The authors introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT), which fine-tunes LLMs on fictitious knowledge to vary one factor at a time (such as redundancy and lexical distractors), and analyze replacing cross-entropy gradients with negative log-odds gradients alongside per-token score aggregation.
I8gk1yGgBf.key_idea: Controlled synthetic fact-tracing isolates attribution failures, while replacing cross-entropy gradients with negative log-odds gradients highlights localized causal tokens instead of diluting them via document-wide averaging.
I8gk1yGgBf.evidence: Controlled fine-tuning experiments on the synthetic CATT benchmark varying document redundancy and lexical distractors.

40Arf70gfe.one_liner: Learns discrete spatial part prototypes and quantized residual attributes from a frozen self-supervised vision backbone.
40Arf70gfe.problem: Concept-based vision models typically rely on fixed class labels or language supervision to define human-inspectable concepts.
40Arf70gfe.method: DisParQ assigns each image patch exclusively to one prototype from a learnable dictionary with sparse per-image activation, while quantizing continuous per-concept residuals into discrete appearance attributes. A spatial decoder reconstructs the frozen vision backbone's features solely from these discrete concepts and attributes without labels or language.
40Arf70gfe.key_idea: Assign patches exclusively to sparse learnable part prototypes with quantized residual attributes trained by reconstructing frozen vision-backbone features.
40Arf70gfe.evidence: Evaluated across seven benchmarks—ImageNet, PartImageNet, Places, CUB, Cars, Dogs, and Flowers—using a frozen DINOv2 teacher.
40Arf70gfe.claimed_gains: Achieves 83.2% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet linear probing, closely matching its frozen DINOv2 teacher.

xgl047l4Mj.one_liner: Adapts CLIP in few-shot settings by projecting text-conditioned class residuals orthogonal to the text-classifier subspace.
xgl047l4Mj.problem: CLIP few-shot adaptation methods lack a unified geometric view and often degrade open-category flexibility when adapting to fixed label spaces.
xgl047l4Mj.method: Motivated by a modality-gap geometric analysis of visual-classifier mismatch, Text-Conditioned Orthogonal Compensation (TCOC) uses a shared text-conditioned generator to produce class-wise residuals. Projecting these residuals onto the orthogonal complement of the principal text-classifier subspace preserves the original text anchor while generalizing to unseen classes.
xgl047l4Mj.key_idea: Generate class residuals with a shared text-conditioned network and project them onto the orthogonal complement of the principal text-classifier subspace.
xgl047l4Mj.evidence: Evaluated on standard few-shot classification and multiple generalization settings.

JTTUWxqEfs.one_liner: Adds an episodic memory replay path to LLM-JEPA for joint token prediction and representation alignment.
JTTUWxqEfs.problem: Strong view alignment in LLM-JEPA does not always translate into accurate and stable downstream predictions.
JTTUWxqEfs.method: ER-JEPA extends LLM-JEPA with an episodic memory that stores training pairs and retrieves relevant stored pairs at each training step. Training jointly on the current batch and retrieved pairs provides extra supervision for both token prediction and representation alignment.
JTTUWxqEfs.key_idea: Store training pairs in episodic memory and retrieve relevant pairs at each step to co-supervise LLM-JEPA alignment and token prediction.
JTTUWxqEfs.evidence: Evaluated against LLM-JEPA across four datasets (NL-RX, GSM8K, Spider, NQ-Open) and four models (Llama-3.2, Gemma-2, Qwen3, Granite-4.2).

2dNbwYy8Ho.one_liner: Uses Diffusion LLMs to sample diverse prompt-response pairs for continuous adversarial training of LLMs.
2dNbwYy8Ho.problem: Adversarially trained LLMs remain vulnerable to simple exploits like rephrasing or repeated sampling due to narrow coverage of the data distribution.
2dNbwYy8Ho.method: Distributional Adversarial Training (DAT) uses Diffusion LLMs to approximate the joint prompt-response distribution and generate diverse, high-likelihood samples. It combines optimization over this diffusion-generated distribution with continuous adversarial training.
2dNbwYy8Ho.key_idea: Approximate the joint prompt-response distribution with Diffusion LLMs and optimize continuous adversarial training over generated samples.
2dNbwYy8Ho.evidence: Compared against previous adversarial training methods for LLMs.

ZYDYxiyTd8.one_liner: Evolves executable compositional workflow skills hierarchically using execution traces and image-quality feedback for agentic generation.
ZYDYxiyTd8.problem: Predefined agentic image-generation workflows fail to convert execution experience into reusable improved procedures for complex synthesis and editing requests.
ZYDYxiyTd8.method: EvoSkillGen represents workflows as executable Skills of meta-operations with explicit instructions and artifact dependencies, combining Skill Adaptation (L1) to select or form temporary workflows with Skill-Bank Evolution (L2) to revise and distill Skills from execution traces guided by output image quality. The authors also introduce GenAgentEval across six existing benchmarks.
ZYDYxiyTd8.key_idea: Compose workflows from executable meta-operation Skills and evolve the Skill bank using execution traces gated by generated image quality.
ZYDYxiyTd8.evidence: Evaluated on GenAgentEval, built from six existing benchmarks covering text-to-image generation, image editing, workflow overhead, and trace diagnostics.
ZYDYxiyTd8.claimed_gains: Improves image-quality macro-averages over the strongest baselines by 0.9–1.8 points for text-to-image and 2.3–2.8 points in the other reported track.

tmVDnWYQ3T.one_liner: Refines a video generator's own coarse human motion into 3D mesh and depth conditions for coherent regeneration.
tmVDnWYQ3T.problem: Human video generators suffer progressive body deformation and appearance drift on complex motions, while motion-controlled methods require external reference motion sequences.
tmVDnWYQ3T.method: ReMoVe treats a base video generator's coarse output as a motion hypothesis, recovers and refines its underlying 3D motion, renders it as a 3D mesh with transferred facial appearance, and derives scene depth from the 3D scene and camera trajectory. Conditioning the video generator jointly on mesh and depth improves motion fidelity, identity, and camera control.
tmVDnWYQ3T.key_idea: Extract and refine 3D motion from a generator's own coarse video, then re-condition generation on the textured 3D mesh and camera-aligned scene depth.
tmVDnWYQ3T.evidence: Evaluated across human structural stability, appearance consistency, temporal coherence, and motion-following fidelity experiments.

OrpIljWXjS.one_liner: Supervises an action-DiT inverse dynamics model with training-only camera-reprojected feature alignment from frozen VGGT tokens.
OrpIljWXjS.problem: Inverse dynamics models trained only on absolute end-effector poses and gripper states overfit appearance cues and generalize poorly to unseen tasks.
OrpIljWXjS.method: GeoIDM feeds visual tokens from a frozen VGGT encoder through a lightweight query compressor into an action DiT. During training only, it accumulates predicted translations, reprojects the estimated future end-effector position into the future view via camera calibration, and applies a gated local contrastive alignment loss against current-frame features.
OrpIljWXjS.key_idea: Reproject accumulated predicted end-effector translations into future views to align frozen VGGT visual features via a gated local contrastive loss during training.
OrpIljWXjS.evidence: Evaluated on offline action prediction in AgiBot, reference-video replay in LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0, and opening, clicking, and grasping tasks on a physical Franka robot.

K5tNDhKqB3.one_liner: Introduces FVH-Bench to evaluate whether text-to-image generators produce visual artifacts that enable harmful functions.
K5tNDhKqB3.problem: Existing image-generation safety benchmarks target overtly harmful depictions and miss functional visual harm from diagrams, interfaces, or records that enable dangerous or deceptive actions.
K5tNDhKqB3.method: The authors define functional visual harm (FVH) and construct FVH-Bench with 669 prompts spanning five harmful visual functions and ten risk domains. They evaluate refusal behavior, target harm realization, artifact usability, and existing safety-detector coverage.
K5tNDhKqB3.key_idea: Benchmark image-generator safeguards and safety detectors on 669 prompts testing whether generated visual artifacts functionally enable harm.
K5tNDhKqB3.evidence: Evaluates 11 image generators and existing safety detectors on FVH-Bench across five harmful visual functions and ten risk domains.

LPG3GPOIqm.one_liner: Decouples sketch stroke budget from complexity using a closed contour, learnable-opacity detail strokes, and coverage-based pruning.
LPG3GPOIqm.problem: Fixed-budget photo-to-vector methods render every stroke, conflating maximum expressive capacity with rendered sketch complexity across diverse images.
LPG3GPOIqm.method: AdaSketch draws one closed silhouette contour plus a pool of detail strokes with learnable opacity, optimizing them under a progressive contour-to-detail schedule. Detail stroke survival is determined by coverage of salient interior points (faithfulness) with minimal strokes (conciseness) controlled by a continuous abstraction parameter.
LPG3GPOIqm.key_idea: Uses a closed contour, learnable-opacity detail strokes, and a progressive contour-to-detail coverage objective so strokes earn visibility independently of the total budget.
LPG3GPOIqm.evidence: Evaluated against five existing photo-to-vector methods on five semantic, structural, and perceptual metrics, plus target-specific sketching in multi-object scenes.
LPG3GPOIqm.claimed_gains: Under the same stroke budget, AdaSketch outperforms five existing methods on all five semantic, structural, and perceptual metrics.

XKFGWcNoFF.one_liner: Exposes date-cue shortcuts in text-assisted forecasting and mitigates them via paired shortcut-controlled residual adaptation.
XKFGWcNoFF.problem: Text-assisted time series forecasters rely on calendar and timestamp cues in documents to infer periodic phase rather than actual event semantics.
XKFGWcNoFF.method: The authors run controlled text interventions (reversing event semantics vs. masking dates/timestamps) to diagnose the calendar shortcut, then introduce SPRA, a backbone-agnostic low-rank residual adapter trained with shortcut-controlled document pairs and a paired consistency objective to produce state-conditioned multi-horizon residual corrections for a frozen forecaster.
XKFGWcNoFF.key_idea: Trains a state-conditioned low-rank residual adapter on shortcut-controlled document pairs with a paired consistency objective to suppress calendar cues and extract event residuals.
XKFGWcNoFF.evidence: Controlled interventions across six settings and forecasting evaluations across five forecasting backbones and nine domains.
XKFGWcNoFF.claimed_gains: Reversing event semantics alters MAE by less than 1%, whereas masking dates reproduces at least 74% of the full text-removal penalty in five of six settings and removes 39-64% of text gain upon retraining.

tiTr9uvctT.one_liner: Automates verified stateful tool-environment construction and synthesizes multi-turn trajectories via topology-aware sampling and implicitness injection.
tiTr9uvctT.problem: Agentic RL for tool use is bottlenecked by scarce executable environments and synthetic trajectories that lack realistic difficulty and implicit human reasoning.
tiTr9uvctT.method: EnvFactory autonomously explores and verifies stateful executable tool environments from authentic resources, then synthesizes multi-turn SFT and RL trajectories using topology-aware sampling and implicitness injection to produce grounded queries with realistic intents.
tiTr9uvctT.key_idea: Couples automated verification of stateful tool environments with topology-aware sampling and implicitness injection for multi-turn trajectory synthesis.
tiTr9uvctT.evidence: Generates 2,575 SFT and RL trajectories from 85 environments across 7 domains and evaluates Qwen3 models (1.7B to 8B) on BFCL-v3 multi-turn, MCP-Atlas, tau^2-Bench, and VitaBench.
tiTr9uvctT.claimed_gains: Improves Qwen3 (1.7B–8B) over base models by up to 15.0 points on BFCL-v3 multi-turn, 8.6 on MCP-Atlas, 4.9 on tau^2-Bench, and 8.3 on VitaBench.

HEt46tfylf.one_liner: Replicates two neuroimaging generative models against trivial baselines to show image-quality metrics mask task failures.
HEt46tfylf.problem: Standard natural-image metrics (SSIM, MSE, PSNR, FID/KID) fail to detect task failures in neuroimaging generative models because clinically relevant signals are tiny deviations from shared anatomy.
HEt46tfylf.method: The authors replicate two open-source models—BrLP (latent-diffusion disease progression) and NT-ViT (EEG-conditioned fMRI generation)—and apply falsification-oriented evaluations comparing them against trivial baselines (identity mapping, random subject matching, population trends, static mean volume) and task-specific metrics.
HEt46tfylf.key_idea: Falsifies neuroimaging generative claims by pairing task-specific metrics with trivial anatomical baselines such as identity mappings and static mean volumes.
HEt46tfylf.evidence: Case-study replications of BrLP and NT-ViT comparing published SSIM/PSNR scores against trivial baselines and task-specific volumetric/time-series metrics.

wjjd7V8cjz.one_liner: Conditions latent diffusion inverse solvers via a 1M-parameter learned latent degradation operator and matrix-free Jacobian-vector linear solves.
wjjd7V8cjz.problem: Latent diffusion inverse-problem solvers either restrict to fixed degradations for speed or backpropagate through the diffusion network for generality at high compute and memory cost.
wjjd7V8cjz.method: PASEO trains a ~1M-parameter network to apply degradations in latent space and samples approximate posteriors by perturbing with noise and solving linear equations using a local linear approximation via Jacobian-vector products, avoiding denoiser/autoencoder backprop and explicit covariance matrices.
wjjd7V8cjz.key_idea: Approximates posterior conditioning via matrix-free linear solves using Jacobian-vector products of a small learned latent degradation network.
wjjd7V8cjz.evidence: Evaluated on super-resolution, deblurring, and inpainting tasks on FFHQ and COCO datasets.
wjjd7V8cjz.claimed_gains: Runs up to 19x faster and uses up to 34% less peak memory than tested baselines with the same or fewer model evaluations.

aK4HPUjnQT.one_liner: Combines controllable image generation/editing with single-image VLM verification to synthesize multi-image relational QA for GRPO training.
aK4HPUjnQT.problem: Vision-language models struggle to relate multiple images because paired multi-view or before-and-after training data with verified cross-image relationships is hard to collect from real photos.
aK4HPUjnQT.method: ReSynth pairs Qwen-Image-2.1 (localized editing and viewpoint generation) with Qwen3-VL-8B (captioning, grounding, counting) to verify single-image facts and assemble multi-image QA pairs, then trains VLMs via GRPO on ~440K synthetic questions with no real images.
aK4HPUjnQT.key_idea: Generates controlled multi-view and edited image pairs, verifies single-image object counts and attributes, and composes cross-image relational QA for GRPO.
aK4HPUjnQT.evidence: Trains Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B with GRPO on ~440K synthetic questions and evaluates on BLINK, MUIRBench, VLM2-Bench, and four single-image benchmarks.
aK4HPUjnQT.claimed_gains: Improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 17.73 average points and Qwen3-VL-8B by 6.10 average points on BLINK, MUIRBench, and VLM2-Bench without real training images.

r6FRihPOyh.one_liner: Constructs the TheaterAct dataset and uses a token-wise acting-mode matrix for content-variant emotion-aligned acting generation from scripts.
r6FRihPOyh.problem: Existing text-to-motion and stylization methods keep motion content fixed while rescaling style, whereas real acting changes physical actions as emotional intensity shifts.
r6FRihPOyh.method: The authors collect TheaterAct (7.2 hours of professional acting from 59 characters with aligned scripts, dialogue, motion, and emotion labels) and build Acting Mind (dramaturgical context projector), Acting Morph (token-wise acting-mode matrix indexed by script semantics, emotion axis, and continuous intensity), and Acting Creation.
r6FRihPOyh.key_idea: Allocates continuous emotion-axis control to individual script tokens through a performance-grounded token-wise acting-mode matrix rather than a global style code.
r6FRihPOyh.evidence: Constructs and evaluates on the 7.2-hour TheaterAct dataset (quantitative results truncated in abstract).

d7IQMI2ZUv.one_liner: Distills an LLM's English-privileged teacher distribution into its own low-resource on-policy rollouts for multilingual math reasoning.
d7IQMI2ZUv.problem: LLM mathematical reasoning lags severely in low-resource languages, while outcome-only RL provides sparse and unstable supervision.
d7IQMI2ZUv.method: Crosslingual On-Policy Self-Distillation (COPSD) uses the same model as student and teacher: the student generates rollouts from only the low-resource problem, while the teacher receives the English translation and reference solution, minimizing full-distribution token-level divergence on the student's rollouts.
d7IQMI2ZUv.key_idea: Minimizes full-distribution token-level divergence on a model's own low-resource rollouts against a self-teacher conditioned on English translations and solutions.
d7IQMI2ZUv.evidence: Evaluated across model sizes on 17 low-resource African languages and harder multilingual reasoning benchmarks against GRPO and SFT baselines.

sJ7KUx26PC.one_liner: Transforms quantization-sensitive LLM gradients into isotropic coordinates via one-sided low-rank geometry approximations before low-precision communication.
sJ7KUx26PC.problem: Direct or data-independent low-precision gradient quantization (e.g., FP8) incurs direction-dependent distortion because LLM gradients are strongly anisotropic across layers.
sJ7KUx26PC.method: GIFT estimates layer geometry with a one-sided low-rank approximation and transforms gradients of quantization-sensitive layers into more isotropic coordinates before low-precision quantization, leaving the optimizer, training recipe, collective, and precision format unchanged.
sJ7KUx26PC.key_idea: Applies a one-sided low-rank coordinate transform to isotropize gradients in quantization-sensitive layers prior to low-precision communication.
sJ7KUx26PC.evidence: Evaluated on Llama-style models of approximately 600M and 2B parameters compared against Muon training with FP32 communication.

DE9uLH7XWP.one_liner: Coordinates heterogeneous robots over long horizons via closed-loop global task awareness and collaborative-state-mining GRPO.
DE9uLH7XWP.problem: Existing multi-robot systems use static predefined task allocation that fails to adapt to dynamic long-horizon execution across heterogeneous robots.
DE9uLH7XWP.method: SynerMind combines SynerMind-Brain (an agentic model aligning evolving task progress with robot capabilities), SynerMind-Flow (closed-loop perception, planning, execution, and reflection), and Collaborative-State Mining GRPO (mining unresolved coordination failures from group reward statistics), alongside two real-world datasets (SynerAwareness-20k and SynerAgentic-102k).
DE9uLH7XWP.key_idea: Pairs a closed-loop heterogeneous multi-robot coordinator with GRPO that mines unresolved collaborative failure states from group reward statistics.
DE9uLH7XWP.evidence: Evaluated in simulation and supported by two real-world datasets, SynerAwareness-20k and SynerAgentic-102k.
DE9uLH7XWP.claimed_gains: Achieves a 1.53x higher success rate than existing baselines (comparison target truncated in abstract).

CZKtAvuy0s.one_liner: Uses a training-free VLM agent writing programs in an edge-selection DSL with UV feedback to plan 3D mesh seams.
CZKtAvuy0s.problem: Automatic UV unwrapping of large production-grade quad meshes struggles to produce artist-aligned seam layouts and scales poorly with autoregressive seam prediction.
CZKtAvuy0s.method: MESHQUERY pairs a queryable mesh representation with an edge-selection domain-specific language (DSL) over topological, geometric, and semantic attributes. A training-free VLM conditioned on natural-language UV-unwrapping knowledge synthesizes compact seam programs and iteratively refines them from UV quality feedback.
CZKtAvuy0s.key_idea: Decouples VLM seam planning from edge selection via a queryable mesh DSL program iteratively refined using UV quality feedback.
CZKtAvuy0s.evidence: Evaluated on Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K meshes with seam metrics and professional artist preference studies.
CZKtAvuy0s.claimed_gains: Produces 2.9x/4.29x fewer charts and 1.63x/1.7x shorter seams than the strongest baseline on Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K, with 80.9% artist preference.

9UjCKdjvkl.one_liner: Continued-pretrains SwiGLU LLMs using the native gate projection as a fixed top-k activation-sparsity router with optional QAT.
9UjCKdjvkl.problem: Routing with native SwiGLU gates in pretrained LLMs performs poorly without training, yet early channel selection is needed to avoid fetching unused FFN weights during decoding.
9UjCKdjvkl.method: SGA-Sparse converts pretrained SwiGLU LLMs into fixed-budget activation-sparse models by updating all parameters during ~30B-token continued pretraining with the native gate projection acting as a top-k router and no auxiliary parameters, plus continued-QAT (4-bit) and joint-QAT (sub-4-bit) recipes.
9UjCKdjvkl.key_idea: Sparsity-aware continued pretraining repurposes the native SwiGLU gate projection as a parameter-free top-k FFN router, reversing frozen gate-vs-up routing order.
9UjCKdjvkl.evidence: Evaluated on LLaMA models from 1B to 8B after ~30B continued-pretraining tokens on zero-shot accuracy and weight-traffic equivalent bit-width.
9UjCKdjvkl.claimed_gains: Achieves uniform per-token 75–85% FFN channel sparsity within 0.2–2.7 percentage points of original dense checkpoints in average zero-shot accuracy.

D9nZtpdcvN.one_liner: Compresses agent trajectories in-situ via Hypothesis-Action-Result micro-chains regulated by an autoregressive hierarchical state machine.
D9nZtpdcvN.problem: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate growing interaction context, while existing compression methods add auxiliary-model overhead or lose structured relationships.
D9nZtpdcvN.method: Auto-Regressive State Machine (ARSM) is a training-free framework combining trajectory abstraction into Hypothesis-Action-Result (HAR) micro-chains with a dynamic state machine that manages hierarchical memory via atomic operations and a compression-control parameter within each autoregressive output.
D9nZtpdcvN.key_idea: Unifies external action generation and internal hierarchical memory updates inside an autoregressive state machine over Hypothesis-Action-Result micro-chains.
D9nZtpdcvN.evidence: Evaluated on WebShop, Multi-Objective Multi-Hop QA, and SWE-Bench Lite datasets (results truncated in abstract).

x5uT9IMk34.one_liner: Measures per-layer loss curvature in 2L forward passes without Hessians to fix displacement-based compression layer rankings.
x5uT9IMk34.problem: Post-training layer selection typically ranks layers by output displacement alone, ignoring loss curvature and ranking high-curvature layers below chance.
x5uT9IMk34.method: CurvProbe factorizes compression damage into operation displacement times checkpoint curvature and estimates a per-layer curvature profile once per frozen checkpoint using 2L forward passes with no backward pass or Hessian, repairing layer rankings across compression operations.
x5uT9IMk34.key_idea: Profiles per-layer checkpoint loss curvature once in 2L forward passes without backprop and multiplies it with operation displacement to rank layers.
x5uT9IMk34.evidence: Evaluated across 18 checkpoints and 11 compression operations, including 25% layer compression and low-rank approximation on Llama-3-8B evaluated on LAMBADA.
x5uT9IMk34.claimed_gains: Retains 65.8% LAMBADA accuracy on Llama-3-8B after low-rank approximation of a quarter of layers, compared to 55.8% for Block Influence.

CHDAgfFsM1.one_liner: Registers backdoor triggers and a stealthy ChainTint trigger in diffusion models to propagate backdoors through clean-label synthetic data.
CHDAgfFsM1.problem: Reusing unverified public diffusion models as synthetic data suppliers can silently propagate backdoors into downstream classifiers via clean-label augmented images.
CHDAgfFsM1.method: Data-Chain Backdoor (DCB) registers backdoor triggers into diffusion models—either from scratch or via fine-tuning—so ordinary target-class prompts reproduce triggered images without special prompt wording; the authors also design ChainTint for faithful diffusion propagation and stealth against defenses.
CHDAgfFsM1.key_idea: Fine-tunes diffusion models to emit backdoor triggers (including stealthy ChainTint) on ordinary target-class prompts for passive clean-label data poisoning.
CHDAgfFsM1.evidence: Evaluated across diffusion models, downstream classifiers, backdoor defenses, data-scarce learning, and dermatological image classification.

Nj3idfhpC3.one_liner: Projects an observation-dependent predictor onto the linear measurement fiber and uses flow matching to generate only the null-space residual.
Nj3idfhpC3.problem: Measurement-consistent generative inverse solvers constrain transport to the affine feasible fiber but leave open how to optimally center the transport within that fiber.
Nj3idfhpC3.method: LOCUS predicts an observation-dependent reconstruction, projects it onto the feasible affine fiber A^dagger y + ker(A), and applies flow matching solely to generate the remaining null-space residual, preserving measurements throughout sampling. The authors prove excess center error relative to the conditional mean equals excess displacement energy and ideal marginal-flow action.
Nj3idfhpC3.key_idea: Centers measurement-consistent flow matching at a projected observation-dependent prediction so transport generates only the null-space residual.
Nj3idfhpC3.evidence: Supported by transport-action theory and 17 large-cohort evaluations on FFHQ, CelebA-HQ, and ImageNet across block/random inpainting and 4x–16x super-resolution.

VGzQWmL9Pb.one_liner: Groups chemical tasks via gradient-affinity MIP and consolidates specialists into a student with generalist-anchored on-policy distillation.
VGzQWmL9Pb.problem: Consolidating specialized chemical reasoning models via multi-teacher on-policy distillation lacks principled task grouping and suffers when specialist guidance replaces generalist supervision.
VGzQWmL9Pb.method: ChemOPD estimates task affinities from SFT gradients and solves a constrained mixed-integer program (MIP) to form partially overlapping specialist groups. During on-policy distillation, an anchor-residual objective retains a generalist teacher and gradually increases routed specialist contributions on student-generated responses.
VGzQWmL9Pb.key_idea: Solves a gradient-affinity MIP for overlapping specialist groups and blends routed specialist teachers with a generalist anchor during on-policy distillation.
VGzQWmL9Pb.evidence: Evaluated on ChemCoTBench comparing affinity-guided specialization and anchor-residual OPD against semantic grouping and specialist-only distillation.

rEOJmuQQJT.one_liner: Augments on-policy safe RL cost critics with uncertainty-aware episodic retrieval corrections under bounded Bellman and trust-region guarantees.
rEOJmuQQJT.problem: On-policy safe RL offers stability and constraint guarantees but poor sample efficiency, whereas off-policy methods sacrifice theoretical safety guarantees.
rEOJmuQQJT.method: The Safe Integration Framework (SIF) defines admissible critic corrections that inject off-policy bias into on-policy value estimates while preserving Bellman contraction, trust-region guarantees up to an explicit slack, and primal-dual convergence to a bounded neighborhood. Instantiated as SPEC, a retrieval-based plugin adds uncertainty-aware episodic corrections to on-policy cost critics.
rEOJmuQQJT.key_idea: Injects uncertainty-aware episodic retrieval corrections into on-policy cost critics within an admissible bias class that preserves Bellman contraction and primal-dual bounds.
rEOJmuQQJT.evidence: Supported by Bellman, trust-region, and primal-dual convergence theory plus experiments applying SPEC to TRPO-PID on six maximum-difficulty Safety-Gymnasium tasks (Button, Goal, Circle).
